Ghee alone is an excellent alternative to butter for those who are lactose intolerant and who want the taste of butter, without the disadvantages of processed margarine. Unlike other oils it is rich in butyric acid, a short chain fatty acid that is great for your overall health and digestion. Fourth & Heart grass-fed ghee uses the highest quality grass-fed butter sourced from a cooperative of farms in New Zealand. Grass is naturally high in Vitamin A, D, E, K and CLA. When the cow’s milk is rich with these vitamins it goes directly to the butter and, therefore, the ghee. Replace your everyday butter & oil with Grass-Fed Pure Spreadable Butter. Please note: ghee naturally melts at approximately 90-degrees farenheit, which can occur during transit and delivery. This is perfectly normal and will not damage the ghee, which will re-solidify if left at room temperature or refrigerated for 2-3 hours.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Annie’s Cheddar Mac (as we call it!) is our answer to all those chemically orange colored cheeses out there. We’ve taken our original Shells & White Cheddar and added a little color to it, naturally! Our totally natural cheese is colored with a plant extract called annatto. Annatto has been used in tropical American cultures for generations to color foods such as butter, cheese and mustard. The annatto tree grows 20 to 30 feet in height and when its seeds are stirred in water, they produce orange annatto dye, also called achiote, to color foods. Annie’s Cheddar Macaroni and cheese is a great alternative for kids who need to have that “orange” cheese on their macaroni.

Our farm-to-table story comes from the essence of cooking hearty stock. We honor timeless, traditional cooking techniques to build flavor and nourishment, taking zero shortcuts and making no compromises. Bare Bones Broths are gelatinous when cold, fragrant when hot, loaded with nutrients, and, oh, so tasty.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Coconut Amino make a great substitute for soy sauces. Coconut Amino have many benefits over soy-based sauces, including 14 times the amino acid content. Many soy sauces on the market are fermented by first soaking the soybeans in water and salt, and then adding specific cultures of molds, yeasts and bacteria to help catalyze the fermentation process. Coconut Amino is made from coconut tree sap, which comes right out of the tree so that vital, active and alive nutrients are blended with sun dried mineral-rich sea salt and aged, without the need for a fermentation booster or added water. Health Secrets of Coconut Amino: When the coconut tree is tapped, it produces a highly nutrient-rich "sap" that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This sap is very low glycemic (GI of only 35), is an abundant source of amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral PH The "Gran Moluccas Sea Salt" used in our Coconut Amino, garners its name from the exotic, tropical island of Mindanao, the 2nd largest island in the Philippines. A local culinary heritage in Mindanao, this unbleached, unrefined, naturally white sea salt, is fed only by the sun and the sea. It is hand-harvested by local salt producers working as their forefathers did, in their ancestral salt fields. Recipe Tips: Use Coconut Amino like soy sauce in dressings, marinades, sautés, and with sushi. Refrigerate after opening. "We love it so much we pour it over almost everything!" Coconut Amigos seasoning sauce is gluten free, contains 65% less sodium than soy sauce, is USDA organic, vegan and non-go.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: De Cecco gently grinds the heart of each grain, mixes it with cold spring water, then kneads the dough slowly. This results in pasta with the exceptional de Cecco aroma, flavor, and consistency. Pasta easily cooks to perfection, has a great firm texture, and a delicious “fresh” pasta taste. It has a rougher surface, which helps the sauce stick to it. Since 1886 we have liked our pasta to be bronze drawn and slowly dried because we like it to fall into the plate full of taste, rough and always "al dente". Even though our taste has not changed, as we feel the same love for tradition, we have continued to improve our production technologies. Make de Cecco pasta the secret ingredient for your most amazing dishes.Buon Appetito! Historically, official mention of the term "spaghetto" can be traced back to the first dictionary of the Italian language by Nicolò Tommaseo and Bernardo Bellini (1819). The word "spaghetto" was included as the "masculine singular diminutive of spago (thread)" and mention is made of "Minestra di Spaghetti" (spaghetti soup) which is pasta the size of a long, thin thread such as sopracapellini". An interesting fact: in 1957, the BBC aired the first documentary on the production of spaghetti and the day after, the television studios were inundated by phone calls from viewers asking for the name of the producers and distributors of spaghetti so they could buy some. Spaghetti is so versatile that it can be served with any condiment, from fish to meat, from vegetables to cheese, but is also excellent served just with extra virgin olive oil and a sprinkling of parmesan. Available in 16.0 oz and 5 lb pack.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Dirty Labs is pushing an outdated industry forward. Most cleaners today use cleaning technologies that were developed almost 100 years ago. While laundry cleaning has evolved over time with some updates and improvements, deep-cleaning formulas still rely heavily on harmful, petroleum-based chemicals. Dirty Labs is different. By combining advanced enzymes and next-generation biobased ingredients, we created Phytolase, a unique, enzyme-driven cleaning technology that delivers exceptional cleaning power without toxic chemicals. Precision targeting: Each enzyme class in Phytolase is designed to target a specific type of stain. Once an enzyme finds its specific stain, it breaks that stain down into simpler component pieces that lift and rinse away. Active stain processing: After working on one stain, enzymes actively target new stains and continue breaking down more stains throughout the duration of the wash cycle. Synergistic, full-spectrum coverage: In addition to enzymes, Phytolase utilizes plant and sugar-derived surfactants to unlock additional enzyme performance and break down grease and oils. Together, they bolster each other to provide exceptional, deep cleaning on a full spectrum of tough stains. Anti-redeposition: With traditional detergents, stains can often redeposit back onto clothing and fabrics during the wash cycle. Our enzymes break down stains into water-miscible component pieces, allowing stains to lift and rinse away with your wash water. Brighter colors: Our biobased ingredients are gentler on clothing and have demonstrated better color stability and reduced color bleeding in fabrics. Phytolase also removes dirt and microfibrils that make your clothes and fabrics look dull and less vibrant—meaning newer-looking clothes that can be worn for longer.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our Lavender Facial Tonic Hydrosol is sourced from a few small, organic farms. It is distilled solely for its hydrophilic (water-loving) components, not the essential oil. Distillers of essential oils usually use plant material that has been dried over several days, resulting in a loss of approximately 70% of water volume. We choose to distill for the hydrosol alone and use only fresh plant material. In this way the resulting hydrosol is much richer in the valuable, water-soluble aromatic molecules. Furthermore, these hydrosols are artisan-distilled at low temperatures for over two to three hours. Conventional distillation utilizes high temperatures, and the process lasts for only thirty to forty-five minutes. The more labor-intensive artisan process that we choose to use creates a hydrosol that is vitalizing and healing for all skin conditions. Pure plant hydrosols are some of nature's best antioxidants. They play an important role in protecting the skin from free radicals and pollution. Saturating the skin daily with these precious waters restores pH balance, refreshes and tones skin tissue, maintaining soft and smooth skin while significantly increasing vitality and hydration to all skin conditions. clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Bright, balanced, and unmistakably real. Numi's Aged Earl Grey opens with a robust black tea base and finishes with a bright, citrusy lift from real bergamot — no artificial flavoring, no perfume-like aftertaste. It's smooth enough to sip plain, bold enough to take milk, and holds its flavor beautifully over ice. That balance comes from time. We age organic Assam black tea with true bergamot oil for several weeks, allowing the citrus to fully infuse into the leaf rather than simply coating it. The result is a rounder, more integrated cup than teas flavored with bergamot essence alone. We start with fuller leaf, hand-plucked Assam from Tonganagaon, the largest organic Fair Trade tea estate in India. Larger leaves have more surface area to unfurl and steep evenly, releasing flavor gradually instead of the fast, tannic bitterness typical of machine-picked fannings and dust used in many tea bags. Sourcing from Tonganagaon also means your tea purchase supports Numi's Together for H2OPE project, which has brought clean water and sanitation to more than 6,500 farming families at the estate. Every tea bag is made from manila hemp (Abacá) fiber, sealed with a crimp-and-knot process instead of the plastic heat-seals used in most tea bags, so no polypropylene ever touches your cup. The bags are BPI Certified Biodegradable and supplier-verified free of added plastics or microplastics — not just labeled that way. The outer wrapper is plant-based and commercially compostable, made from FSC-certified paper and non-GMO sugarcane. Each bag is USDA Certified Organic and Fair Trade Certified. Steep 3–5 minutes in fresh, boiling water for a classic cup, hot or iced.

Unlike other oils on the market, Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil is never processed using hexane or other dangerous chemicals. At Nutiva, we start with organic, non-GMO Southeast Asian coconuts, sustainably harvested and immediately cold pressed to naturally extract the fresh, flavorful coconut oil. Next, Nutiva uses a USDA certified organic process to extract the fats from the virgin coconut oil that remain solid at room temperature, resulting in an oil that remains liquid, even at cooler temperatures. The neutral flavor makes it great for sautéing, baking, or enhancing your favorite recipes. It's ideal as a medium-heat cooking oil, a nutritious substitute in baking and is an excellent alternative to olive oil. It’s also a wholesome addition to vegetarian, vegan, raw, whole food, paleo-friendly, ketogenic, and gluten-free diets. The purity and nutrient density of Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil make it good for you both inside and out. Use the luscious, soothing oil as a natural skin moisturizer, eye make-up remover, deep conditioning hair treatment, or combine it with Nutiva Coconut Sugar and your favorite essential oil for an exfoliating, refreshing body scrub. Nutiva was founded in 1999 with a single purpose in mind - to Revolutionize the Way the World Eats. We produce organic, nutrient-dense foods that are good for you and good for the planet. Social and environmental responsibility is a core part of Nutiva’s culture and business. We are dedicated to sourcing organic products, obtaining fair trade certification, greening our facilities and operations, and funding tree planting at schools in our local community; we are constantly seeking ways to better protect our environment and ensure a better quality of life for employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: For a decaf version of the best loved Peet's Coffee to earn the Major Dickason's name, we felt it had to brew the absolute finest decaf cup in the world. So we used the exact same premium beans as the original to create a blend just as full of flavor, body, and aroma, but without any caffeine. The mellow, satisfying richness stands alone among decafs, whether prepared in a press, by drip, or as espresso. It's the boldest of its kind. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: �On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It's visceral."

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: In our family, a dinner party is not complete without tortilla chips, salsa, and guacamole. Our grain free chips are dairy-free, powered by avocado oil, and made with natural ingredients (and lots of love!). With a selection of flavors like Sea Salt, Lime, Nacho, Fuego, Ranch, Sal y Limón, and No Salt, we hope there’s a flavor that speaks to everyone. Delicious as a solo act or in queso, bean dip, or hot sauce—but the real magic is when our tortilla chips are enjoyed with family and friends around the table. Our Grain Free Tortilla Chips come in all different flavors, shapes and sizes! Our five-ounce tortilla chips are large format, light and crispy cantina-style tortilla chips, while our four-ounce tortilla chips are smaller, thicker triangles full of seasoning: • Sea Salt (5oz) • Lime (5oz) • No Salt (5oz) • Nacho (5oz) • Fuego (4oz) • Ranch (4oz) • Sal y Limón (4oz) • Nacho (4oz)

clip_low_score_products.retailer_description: Joint Vibrance provides cartilage-building cells called chondrocytes with the proper nutrients necessary for construction of new cartilage and synthesis of hyaluronic acid. It is the most comprehensive formula to nutritionally support healthy joint function. The entire formula is truly remarkable, and provides sound nutritional support for joint health. Before we are born, chondrocytes work rapidly to build protection into our developing skeletons. Then we are born, grow, and age. The older we become, the slower chondrocytes work. As chondrocyte activity flags over time, they eventually fail to adequately compensate for the daily wear and tear placed on joints by an active lifestyle. As a result, nearly everyone has some degree of cartilage breakdown by the age of 32 to 35. For centuries it was thought that the gradual deterioration made joint pain and loss of mobility an inevitable fact of aging. Today?s science has shown us that the function of cartilage-building cells (chondrocytes) can be sustained as long as their nutritional requirements are met. Cartilage can indeed be brought back to greater levels of health, strengthened and thickened if proper nutrients are supplied. There is one controlling principle in the effort to rebuild cartilage: There must be some cartilage with viable chondrocytes in the joint in order for repair to proceed. Due to its long shelf life, it was common among shepherds who traversed the island with their flocks for seasons at a time. We have three varieties: Classic, Rosmarino (Rosemary), and Peperoncino (Chili Pepper). Our Toketti combine the authentic flavor of Sardinia with an irresistible crunch. data_issues.retailer_description: Tony’s Chocolonely is more than just chocolate; it’s a mission driven brand that seeks to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. With Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, each bite you take can help combat the widespread issues of child labor, forced labor, and unsustainable farming practices. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a sustainable, ethical, and transparent supply chain that prioritizes farmers and the environment. Our chocolate bars and chocolate chunks come in a wide range of irresistible flavors, perfect for snacks or desserts. From Milk Chocolate to Dark Chocolate Almond Sea Salt, each variety is crafted with care to provide a truly indulgent experience. For those who crave a mix of everything, our Tiny Tony Variety Pack offers 36 individually wrapped coins in 6 delicious flavors, including Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt, Honey Almond Nougat, Almond Sea Salt, and Dark Milk Chocolate Pretzel Toffee—a delight for every taste. These chocolate bars make the perfect gift, whether for a birthday, holiday, or special occasion. And with chocolate this good, there’s no reason to wait! At Tony’s, we also focus on the long term—we work directly with cocoa cooperatives for at least five years to build lasting relationships and create sustainable change. This stability allows farmers to invest in improved farming practices, increase their yields, and reduce deforestation. Tony’s even implements a Child Labor Monitoring and Remediation System to encourage that all workers are regarded with fairness and respect. By purchasing Tony’s Chocolonely, you’re choosing chocolate made with clean ingredients and supporting a movement that demands transparency in the cocoa industry. So whether you’re grabbing a quick snack, enjoying a cozy evening with chocolate desserts, or looking for a sweet gift, know that Tony’s is the chocolate you can feel good about. Join us in the fight for a fairer, more sustainable world.

duplicateish_groups.retailer_description: Meet TRUBAR Kids Protein Bars — the snack that finally checks every box. Designed with parents in mind and kids at heart, these soft, chewy bars deliver a balanced, school-friendly snack made with wholesome ingredients that taste as good as they feel. Made with real, simple ingredients like tapioca fiber, sunflower seeds, gluten-free oats, and sustainably sourced palm oil, TRUBAR Kids bars are free from artificial flavors, fillers, and preservatives. With low sugar (just 4–5 g per bar) and only 140 calories, these individually wrapped protein bars make it easy to snack smart anytime, anywhere. duplicateish_groups.retailer_description: Scattered Peaks is an elevated spin on Napa Valley Cabernet Sauvignon carefully curated and elegantly crafted by wine industry icon, Derek Benham and legendary Napa Valley Winemaker, Joel Aiken. Leveraging their deep passion for – and long history within – the California wine industry, Derek and Joel curate superior fruit from coveted regions throughout Napa Valley. Their plunder is then aged in carefully curated oak barrels and artfully blended to achieve the high levels of quality and experience. Scattered Peaks is a creative marriage of Derek’s greatest loves: surfing, skiing and wine. A powerful triple-entendre, the term ‘Scattered Peaks’ refers to a surfing condition when waves approaching the shore split, creating different wave peaks. Secondly, the term signifies the many snowy peaks around the world that Benham has conquered with unmatched enthusiasm. Finally, ‘Scattered Peaks’ refers to our vineyards dotted across the world-renowned Napa Valley.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Ghee is a type of clarified butter that is heated, reduced & triple-filtered out. What you’re left with is the pure healthy fat, which is lactose free & dairy free, good for digestion and metabolism. Mixed with garlic, its flavor is next level (try it with pasta, veggies, or meat to taste for yourself!). Ghee is an iconic ingredient and food staple with a history as rich as its taste. It originates in India and is used extensively in cooking and to promote health. Ghee alone is an excellent alternative to butter for those who are lactose intolerant and who want the taste of butter, without the disadvantages of processed margarine. Unlike other oils it is rich in butyric acid, a short chain fatty acid that is great for your overall health and digestion. Ghee’s buttery taste and high smoke point (485 degrees) makes it an excellent addition to your everyday cooking oils, is extremely easy to cook with and delicious simply spread on a piece of toast. Fourth & Heart grass-fed ghee uses the highest quality grass-fed butter sourced from a cooperative of farms in New Zealand. Grass is naturally high in Vitamin A, D, E, K and CLA. When the cow’s milk is rich with these vitamins it goes directly to the butter and, therefore, the ghee. Replace your everyday butter & oil with Grass-Fed Pure Spreadable Butter. Please note: ghee naturally melts at approximately 90-degrees farenheit, which can occur during transit and delivery. This is perfectly normal and will not damage the ghee, which will re-solidify if left at room temperature or refrigerated for 2-3 hours.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our black raspberry ice cream is rich, bold, and an extraordinary shade of purple. When we think of purple in the United States, we think not only of the purple mountain majesties where these berries grow, but also of our highest hopes for our country’s identity. We are not a nation divided into red states and blue states—We are more than that. We are better than that. We see America as fifty purple states—complex and distinct, with different histories, stories, and dialects—yet ultimately united by a belief that transcends every border. It is a vision stretching from sea to shining sea. A belief that unites neighbors and is championed on Main Street and Wall Street, in bustling cities and small rural towns alike. The beauty, strength, and greatness of America does not come from a single race, religion, creed, or culture, but from the principle that “All of us are created equal, with certain unalienable rights, that among these are life, liberty, and the pursuit of happiness.” We hope our Black Raspberry ice cream can play a small but delicious part in reminding us to resist division and instead embrace our shared identity as Americans—united by equality, and by the values that truly make our country great. We make ice cream the old-fashioned way—with cream, milk, sugar, and eggs. No stabilizers, emulsifiers, artificial ingredients, or colors. Whenever possible, we source these simple, natural ingredients from nearby family farms and local providers—for better taste, better for you, and better for the planet. Adirondack Creamery continues to be an independent owner-operator company and the majority of our ingredient suppliers, distributors, and farmers are independent family owned businesses.

So when you’re looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we’ve got you covered. ALOHA protein bars use simple, organic ingredients that are naturally packed with the tools your body needs to do its best: protein, iron, fiber, and healthy fats. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of natural sugar, ALOHA’s protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day without the dreaded sugar crash. ALOHA checks the all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. The perfect protein bar for when you’re between meetings, warming up for the gym (or cooling down!), on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: AminoLean is a pre workout powder, amino energy drink, and weight management supplement in a single scoop, built for people who want real energy without the jitters, tingles, or afternoon crash. Alongside them, CLA, L-Carnitine L-Tartrate, green tea extract standardized to 50% EGCG, and green coffee bean extract support natural weight management as part of a calorie-controlled diet and a regular exercise program.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Based on the original Pizza Napoletana, our Vegan Margherita Pizza is made from scratch and has a light, tender crust that's thinner than our usual crust, made from organic wheat flour and extra virgin olive oil, and hand-stretched before being baked. We top it with Amy's slow-simmered tomato sauce - a balance of sun-ripened tomatoes, classic Italian-style seasonings and fragrant basil. What makes this pizza unique is our shredded mozzarella-style cheese alternative, which is free of cholesterol, lactose and other common allergens but full of flavor. It stretches, melts and tastes like the real thing. This is a pizza that provides our vegan and dairy free customers with a familiar cheese pizza experience, and it's one that everyone will love. Amy's Vegan Margherita Pizza is made with non-GMO ingredients and is dairy free, soy free, tree nut free, and suitable for vegetarian, vegan and kosher diets. Amy’s is a proudly independent, family owned, organic food company. We always cook our food with love – we’ve been doing it for over 30 years. For us, that means carefully sourcing high quality, organic ingredients and spending countless hours in our kitchens so that you can enjoy authentic, great-tasting food in minutes.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Unlike competitors that are seeking to ride the wave of the newest fad or trend, Ancient Nutrition Bone Broth Protein was the Original concentrated bone broth protein supplement. In 2016, we were the first to bring concentrated chicken bone broth in protein powder form. At Ancient Nutrition, we formulate whole food nutritional supplements in easily digestible forms so we can take advantage of the nutrition our ancestors enjoyed. Bone broth protein is no exception. For as long as humans have been cooking food over fire, bone broth—the simmering stock of bones from fish, beef, chicken, turkey and other animals that are typically discarded—has been a daily part of life. And it's celebrated by cultures around the world. The modern world makes it difficult to enjoy the benefits of real, homemade broth without spending hours boiling bones in your kitchen. Since life is busy and nutrition should not be compromised we’ve made it so all you have to do is scoop, stir and enjoy! Our Bone Broth Protein begins as a true bone broth liquid. It’s then dehydrated, making it into a concentrated source of high-quality, tasty powder that provides the benefits of a homemade broth, but it’s even more versatile. What's more, Bone Broth Protein supplies 20 grams of bone broth-fueled protein. Ancient Nutrition Bone Broth Protein is unique in the way it is formulated specifically for supporting joints, skin and gut with food sourced collagen peptides. Taking the time to be intentional about our health and wellness can help us thrive in this modern world. At Ancient Nutrition, that is always on our mind. Our products are designed, formulated and delivered as whole food nutritional supplements to power your body and mind and accompany you on your journey to a healthy, happy you!

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Collagen is the most abundant protein in our body. It makes up approximately 30 percent of all proteins and is quite literally the “glue” that holds us together. Your gut, joints, skin, hair, bodily systems and organs need collagen for a variety of different functions, and making sure you have enough of it is beneficial for overall health. Ancient Nutrition’s delicious easy-to-mix powder with smooth chocolate flavor is a nutritional supplement that’s perfect in your favorite drink or baked goods and for a low-carb lifestyle. Chocolate collagen brownies! Most collagen products are only formulated with one or two types of collagen. Here at Ancient Nutrition, we know that different types of collagen can offer different health benefits, so we made our products with multiple sources, including bovine, chicken, marine and more! Our Multi Collagen Protein Powder has been to include 5 types of hydrolyzed collagen peptides that can be added to any smoothie, shake, cold or hot drinks and works great in cooking and baking as well. A full serving will add a boost of collagen to your diet and promote a healthy you! Even though collagen naturally occurs in our body, its production naturally decreases with age, which can affect the skin, joints and more. This means it is important to include collagen in our diet regularly. Adding multiple sources of collagen will help to promote overall skin health and support joint health. Start incorporating Ancient Nutrition Multi Collagen Protein powder into your diet and begin your journey to a healthy, happy you without the fuss and clutter of hard-to- swallow supplement pills. Enjoy adding creamy delicious chocolate to your coffee, oatmeal, morning smoothie or pre/post-workout shake while receiving the benefits of increasing collagen and protein in your diet.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: This vegetable broth from Aneto in Catalonia is just like homemade broth. Made from water, onion, carrot, leek, celery, virgin olive oil, (0.15%) and sea salt, it’s perfect for making your own soups and sauces. We also love this vegetarian broth in stir-fries or for poaching long-cooking vegetables like leeks or kale. At Aneto, located in the town of Artés in Catalonia, Aneto makes entirely natural broths, with 100 % fresh ingredients simmered in a pot over a low heat for three hours, with the aim of equaling the quality and flavor of traditional home-made recipes. Aneto’s secret is that there is only one way to make natural broth: fresh ingredients simmering in a pot over a low heat. Originally, Aneto did not make broths: they have been dedicated to the curing and aging of Serrano hams and charcuterie products for 40 years, attaining throughout the company’s long history a renowned prestige. A few years ago Aneto decided to offer the Spanish market a natural Serrano ham broth made with our own hams. After working on this project for more than 10 years, Aneto mastered the flavors of many Spanish broths and sauces. Today Aneto make a natural broth identical to the one we would make ourselves at home. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Annie’s Cheddar Mac (as we call it!) is our answer to all those chemically orange colored cheeses out there. We’ve taken our original Shells & White Cheddar and added a little color to it, naturally! Our totally natural cheese is colored with a plant extract called annatto. Annatto has been used in tropical American cultures for generations to color foods such as butter, cheese and mustard. The annatto tree grows 20 to 30 feet in height and when its seeds are stirred in water, they produce orange annatto dye, also called achiote, to color foods. Annie’s Cheddar Macaroni and cheese is a great alternative for kids who need to have that “orange” cheese on their macaroni.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers provide the perfect alternative for those who want to enjoy the taste of craft beer without the hangover. Whether you’re craving a crisp IPA, a smooth golden, or a light, refreshing brew, we offer a wide range of styles to satisfy your taste buds. Made with the finest ingredients, our beers include malted barley, hops, yeast, water, and wheat, ensuring a well-balanced, flavorful brew. The secret behind our great taste lies in our careful brewing method, which allows us to craft each Non Alcoholic beer with the same passion and precision as traditional craft brews, while maintaining the same flavor. Perfect for those looking for a mindful alcohol alternative, our beers contain less than 0.5% alcohol by volume, making them suitable for any time of the day. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers are designed for active, health-conscious individuals who love the taste of brews but want to make mindful choices. Our Non Alcoholic beer selection includes classics like Run Wild IPA, Upside Dawn Golden, Athletic Lite, and Free Wave, with regular releases of unique styles and experimental brews that showcase our passion for innovation. Each brew is carefully crafted to provide the same depth of flavor you’d expect from a traditional craft beer, without the unwanted effects. Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beer is your go-to drink. It’s a great fit for any lifestyle, whether you’re indulging in pizza, a salad, or grilling. Perfectly paired with a variety of meals, desserts, and activities, it’s a refreshing choice for anyone who wants to enjoy the taste of beer without the alcohol. With a variety of styles to choose from, including hazy IPAs and light and dark brews, there’s a flavor to suit every palate. From casual drinking to special occasions, Athletic Brewing’s Non Alcoholic beers let you enjoy the best of both worlds: the refreshing taste of craft beer and the benefits of choosing a Non Alcoholic beverage.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Chosen Foods is America's #1 Avocado Oil brand and a Certified B Corporation on a mission to do good in the world by being good for the world, replacing bad fats with the good fats of 100% Pure Avocado Oil across the kitchen pantry. Every batch of our avocado oil is independently tested to confirm 100% purity, and our standard was verified by UC Davis as one of only two brands to pass their quality test. Our Avocado Oil Cooking Sprays are propellant-free and non-aerosol, available in Refined, USDA Organic, and Baking formats. Our Avocado Oil Mayo is whipped with 100% pure avocado oil and cage-free eggs in our Classic recipe, plus a fully plant-based Vegan recipe. Our restaurant-quality Salad Dressings come in Ranch, Caesar, Italian, Balsamic, Lemon Garlic, and Greek Artichoke, all made with real ingredients and zero seed oils. Our Avocado Oil-Based Dipping Sauces deliver bold Chicken, Burger, and Chili flavors in easy-pour squeeze bottles. Every product is held to the same clean-label standard: Non-GMO Project Verified, Gluten-Free, Glyphosate-Residue Free, Kosher, and Keto Friendly, with many Whole30 Approved. We use no soy oil and no canola oil, just simple quality ingredients and the good fats of 100% Pure Avocado Oil in every bottle, jar, and squeeze pack. Taste and feel the difference with Chosen Foods.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Meet the lightweight, nourishing face SPF you’ve been waiting for; one that glides on smoothly and absorbs beautifully. Never heavy. Never dry. Never greasy. Varying climates affect skin differently, so your sunscreen should adapt with the seasons; staying comfortable in heat and humidity, without leaving skin tight and dry in the cold. Our Hydrating Milk Mineral Face Sunscreen SPF 30 is designed for year-round protection. Using a reverse emulsion technology, some of the water is replaced with plant-based emollients, and liquid zinc oxide is seamlessly blended in to create a dewy, nourishing, fluid texture. EWG Verified® to ensure the highest level of safety and transparency and crafted with 16 plant-based ingredients, including sustainably sourced passionfruit oil, our Hydrating Milk Mineral Face Sunscreen delivers broad-spectrum SPF 30 protection, for both clear and sunny or cloud-covered skies alike. Fragrance-free, dermatologist tested, and suitable for sensitive skin. With 40 minutes of water resistance, this face sunscreen is ready to follow you into bright sunshine, salt-kissed sea air, or softly overcast skies, wherever the day takes you.

Our classic 32% milk chocolate is all dressed up with all-natural, non-GMO ingredients and made with traceable cocoa. Most importantly, our Fairtrade Certified chocolate exists to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Share a bar of our fun, crunchy milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.7 oz. Caramel Sea Salt Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Bare Bones Grass-Fed Lemon Ginger Bone Broth Instant Mix is perfect for school, the office, travel, backpacking, and beyond. Its aromatic, delicious flavor makes it the perfect sipping snack. These paleo and keto-friendly "rip sticks" pack the perfect serving of protein, collagen, and prebiotic fiber to fuel you on the go. Just rip, mix with hot water, and sip. Our bone broth warms the soul and nourishes the body, just like Grandma's homemade soup, but now in a convenient instant mix. Made with real bone broth, ground herbs, and spices, our bone broth is traditionally simmered low and slow for 14+ hours to extract protein, collagen, vitamins, and amino acids for the best flavor and nutrition. Enjoy this nutritional broth as a substitute for stock in your favorite recipes, as some added flavor to rice and soup, or as a sipping snack straight from a mug. No artificial flavorings, MSG, antibiotics, growth stimulants, or hormones. Gluten-free, soy-free, paleo, and keto-friendly. Created to inspire people to eat for health and longevity, Bare Bones Bone Broth was founded in 2014 by the health-conscious duo Ryan and Katherine Harvey. Our farm-to-table story comes from the essence of cooking hearty stock. We honor timeless, traditional cooking techniques to build flavor and nourishment, taking zero shortcuts and making no compromises. Bare Bones Broths are gelatinous when cold, fragrant when hot, loaded with nutrients, and, oh, so tasty.

Our process is simple. We source the building blocks of meat directly from plants. Using heating, cooling and pressure, we create the fibrous texture of meat from plant-based proteins. Then, we mix in fats, minerals, fruit and vegetable-based colors, natural flavors, and carbohydrates to replicate the appearance, juiciness, and flavor of meat. The result? Uncompromisingly delicious plant-based burgers, sausage, and beef, no sacrifice required. Beyond Meat products offer greater or equal protein levels than their animal counterparts, no cholesterol, less saturated fat, and no antibiotics or hormones.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: BOLA granola ORIGINAL is the recipe that set our standard, and we have never stopped making it the hard way. Every batch is mixed and baked by hand in Great Barrington, Massachusetts, 36 pounds at a time. Rolled oats, California almonds and pumpkin seeds get tossed with brown sugar, expeller pressed canola oil, wheat flour, wheat bran and wheat germ, a little kosher salt and real vanilla, then toasted until everything turns deep golden. The result is robustly flavorful, salty-sweet and relentlessly crunchy, and it stays that way in milk. WHAT A HALF CUP GIVES YOU 10g of plant protein, 5g of fiber and 280 calories, from almonds and pumpkin seeds rather than a protein powder. Eight servings per 1 lb resealable bag. HOW TO EAT IT Over yogurt. With milk or oat milk. Scattered on a smoothie bowl, over roasted fruit, or on top of ice cream. Straight from the bag by the handful, which is how most of it disappears around here. GOOD TO KNOW 20% nuts. Non-GMO Project Verified. Vegan and dairy-free. Nothing artificial and no preservatives. 1 lb resealable bag, eight servings. ALLERGENS Contains wheat and almonds (tree nuts). ORIGINAL is made with wheat flour, wheat bran and wheat germ and is not a gluten-free product. Some ingredients may be processed in facilities that handle peanuts and tree nuts. There's only one BOLA granola.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our Certified Organic Turkey Bone Broth is handcrafted the same way it has been for centuries: in small batches. We start by using triple filtered water. Adding free-roaming, organic turkey bones. We use locally sourced organic onions, organic garlic, organic sage, organic thyme, organic rosemary, Celtic Sea Salt by Selina Naturally and organic unfiltered apple cider vinegar. The vinegar acts as a magnet to help pull the vitamins and minerals from the bones and into the broth. We then bring the broth to a boil and immediately reduce to a simmer. This slow simmer continues on for 24 hours. An hour before the broth is ready we add fresh organic parsley to pull any remaining minerals from the bones. The broth is then filtered and immediately cooled, packaged in our BPA and EA free bags and then immediately frozen to preserve freshness.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: We work closely with Brew Dr. and they have given approval for shipping this item unrefrigerated. We store these products cold in our warehouse at all times and they need to be refrigerated upon receipt. This product can be sent unrefrigerated because it takes many days for the live cultures to wake up and restart the process of fermentation (which could alter the product taste). We do this to help save you shipping costs, since shipping products cold would require a cooler and gel packs, and 3 day travel zones might even require sending via air to guarantee they arrive cold. We only ship on a date that will allow the product to get to you within a few days via Priority Mail or 2 Day FedEx Ground, so Wednesday is usually the cut-off day for delivery that week. If you have any questions or concerns, please feel free to contact us prior to placing your order. We can not accept returns for this product because it arrives at room temperature, this is why we are letting you know the policy herein.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Limited Release Russian imperial stout. This is the famous Brooklyn Black Chocolate Stout. Warming flavors of thick dark chocolate and roast coffee blend nicely with your own well-earned decadence, tall tales and roaring fireplaces. The Brooklyn story. In the late 70s & early 80s, Steve Hindy was a war correspondent in the Middle east, where foreign diplomats in dry countries discreetly brewed their own beers. Inspired by their tasty beers, Steve later started brewing in Brooklyn with his neighbor, Tom Potter. In 1988, they quit their jobs to found The Brooklyn Brewery. Their goal was grand: return brewing to Brooklyn, once on of the brewing capitals of the world. Today, James Beard Award-winning Brewmaster Garrett Oliver & his team brew a vast portfolio of beers for every palate, from traditional styles to bold experiments. Brooklyn Brewery beers are found in more than half of the U.S. & in 30 countries. In 2013, we opened our first sister brewery, Nya Carnegie, in Stockholm, Sweden. In 2015, we inaugurated a teaching brewhouse or beer curriculum at the famed Culinary Institute of America. We here at The Brooklyn Brewery are Proud to be leaders in todays's innovative & collaborative beer culture. BrooklynBrewery.com. (at)BrooklynBrewery. Visit us in New York City. While in New York City, please plan to visit The Brooklyn Brewery and the Company Store. For news, info on beers, public hours, tours & private events, visit BrooklynBrewery.com. 10.0% abv. 20

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Effortlessly craft extraordinary meals with Pacific Foods Low Sodium Organic Beef Broth. We slow-simmer humanely raised organic beef with onions, garlic and a touch of sea salt for a savory beef broth with 140mg of sodium per serving. Easier to prepare than beef bouillon, this low sodium broth is a delectably simple and nuanced canvas for your favorite dishes. Use it in any recipe that calls for low sodium beef broth, beef stock or water. It’s great as a soup base and for crafting delectable stews and ramen. It also elevates gravies, sauces and marinades, and it enhances the cooking of grains, protein and veggies. Each 32 oz recyclable carton contains approximately 4 servings of our gluten free and USDA Certified Organic broth. In addition to using it for cooking, you can enjoy this savory beef broth on its own as a simple yet flavorful beef soup. Customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a sandwich, salad or wrap. In addition to beef broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken broth, turkey broth, vegetable broth and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Beef Bone Broth. We slow-simmer organic beef bones and vegetables for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen. Sip a cup of warm beef bone broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It’s great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, season with cracked black pepper and fresh herbs. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free of gluten, soy, wheat and yeast. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Beef Bone Broth contains 8 grams of protein, 1 gram of carbs, 0 grams of fat and 40 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this bone broth in any recipe that calls for beef broth, beef stock or water. Try it as a stew or soup base, to enhance gravies and sauces, or to cook grains and veggies. In addition to beef bone broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken bone broth.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Beef Bone Broth. We slow-simmer organic beef bones and vegetables for a savory bone broth that’s full of naturally occurring collagen. Sip a cup of warm beef bone broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It’s great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, season with cracked black pepper and fresh herbs. Our USDA-certified organic bone broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free of gluten, soy, wheat and yeast. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Beef Bone Broth contains 8 grams of protein, 1 gram of carbs, 0 grams of fat and 40 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this bone broth in any recipe that calls for beef broth, beef stock or water. Try it as a stew or soup base, to enhance gravies and sauces, or to cook grains and veggies. In addition to beef bone broth, Pacific Foods also offers chicken bone broth.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: You will love the time-saving convenience of our new Ground Bulletproof Coffee, with all the same purity standards as our existing whole bean coffee. The proprietary Bulletproof Process optimizes every step of coffee production for performance by minimizing the opportunity for performance-robbing mold toxins. Ingesting mold toxins can contribute to chronic health issues. Bulletproof Upgraded Coffee Beans are meticulously grown at high altitude on single estates in Guatemala, hand-harvested, carefully processed, handled and roasted to maintain maximum integrity and flavor. The final roast then undergoes proprietary lab testing to verify that our coffee meets the Bulletproof quality and purity standards. Jump-start your day by blending Upgraded Coffee with Bulletproof Brain Octane and grass-fed, unsalted butter to energize your mind and body for hours.(+) Supports regenerative antioxidant processes and minimized levels of mold toxins, you will feel the Bulletproof difference with your first cup. Sourcing: Our coffee is carefully produced and lab tested using the Bulletproof Process to minimize toxins, so you can enjoy a pure cup of coffee worry-free. After we pick the ripest cherries, we use the proprietary Bulletproof Process to create a special class of green coffee bean with minimized levels of harmful molds, bacteria, and toxins. The beans are then medium roasted in small batches in the United States under the strictest conditions, which minimize the formation of toxins from the roasting process. Roasting the beans enhances their naturally occurring antioxidant capacity and flavor to provide you with a cup of coffee that has a minimized level of performance-robbing mold-toxins.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch 100% Extra Virgin Olive Oil is crafted locally from our Californian farmers in California. This olive oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This accessible gourmet EVOO features well-rounded notes of a floral, buttery and fruity taste. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The recent discovery of aquafaba has led to its earnest adoption by vegan and vegetarian communities, but this special "bean water" is still relatively unknown. Let's begin with what we do know. Aquafaba is the liquid leftover from soaking or cooking garbanzo beans. The water absorbs proteins and starches from the beans, becoming more viscous along the way. Its viscosity is similar to that of eggs and egg whites, making aquafaba the perfect egg substitute. We've blended aquafaba with our favorite oil—100% pure avocado oil—to create a 100% vegan mayo that can truly be described as plant-based. Use our mayo as you normally would—on sandwiches, wraps, or as a base for sauces and dressings.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Coconut Amino make a great substitute for soy sauces. Coconut Amino have many benefits over soy-based sauces, including 14 times the amino acid content. Many soy sauces on the market are fermented by first soaking the soybeans in water and salt, and then adding specific cultures of molds, yeasts and bacteria to help catalyze the fermentation process. Coconut Amino is made from coconut tree sap, which comes right out of the tree so that vital, active and alive nutrients are blended with sun dried mineral-rich sea salt and aged, without the need for a fermentation booster or added water. Health Secrets of Coconut Amino: When the coconut tree is tapped, it produces a highly nutrient-rich "sap" that exudes from the coconut blossoms. This sap is very low glycemic (GI of only 35), is an abundant source of amino acids, minerals, vitamin C, broad-spectrum B vitamins, and has a nearly neutral PH The "Gran Moluccas Sea Salt" used in our Coconut Amino, garners its name from the exotic, tropical island of Mindanao, the 2nd largest island in the Philippines. A local culinary heritage in Mindanao, this unbleached, unrefined, naturally white sea salt, is fed only by the sun and the sea. It is hand-harvested by local salt producers working as their forefathers did, in their ancestral salt fields. Recipe Tips: Use Coconut Amino like soy sauce in dressings, marinades, sautés, and with sushi. Refrigerate after opening. "We love it so much we pour it over almost everything!" Coconut Amigos seasoning sauce is gluten free, contains 65% less sodium than soy sauce, is USDA organic, vegan and non-go.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Bodega Colome is nestled in the Calchaqui Valley, 2300 meters (7500 feet) above sea level, in the Argentine northwest. Founded in 1831, it is one of the oldest existing wineries in Argentina. In 2001, it was acquired by the Hess Family Estates. Those who enjoy their wines recognize in them the true taste of wines made with grapes of the highest quality and grown in the highest vineyards in the world (7218-10,207 feet above sea level) reflecting the soul of its terroir. Bodega y Estancia Colome's philosophy consists in the commitment to implement biodynamic agriculture, whose principles were outlined by the researcher Rudolf Steiner.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The Compostic Variety Pack puts four bag sizes in one box: 50 snack bags, 50 sandwich bags, 25 quart bags and 20 gallon bags, 145 bags in total. Every bag has a resealable zip-seal closure that locks in freshness for meal prep, school lunches, snack packing and freezer storage, and all four sizes are microwave and freezer safe. Certified home compostable and made from plant-based materials with zero conventional plastic, it breaks down completely in a home compost bin in 12 to 24 weeks and leaves no microplastics behind. BPA free, GMO free and tested for direct food contact. Even the carton is plastic free, printed with soy-based inks on compostable board. Compostic was founded in New Zealand with one mission: rid the world of plastic waste.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Crazy Mountain Lime is crafted for adventurers, creators, and anyone who wants the ritual of beer with a clean, easy-drinking non-alcoholic experience. Each 12 oz can is brewed to deliver a bright, crisp, naturally flavored lime profile with a hint of citrus, while keeping the fuller body drinkers expect from a cold lager. Lime offers a refreshing, subtly citrus-forward taste that preserves authentic beer character. Whether you are stocking the fridge, packing cans for a cookout, pairing with dinner, or reaching for one chilled beer can after a long day, Crazy Mountain Lime provides a satisfying alcohol alternative that still feels like a real brew. Instead of removing alcohol after brewing, Crazy mountain uses a specialized yeast that produces less alcohol, eliminating the need for alcohol removal after fermentation to naturally create a non-alcoholic result with 0.5% ABV or less. Classic ingredients like water, malted barley, corn and rice, hops, and yeast support a crisp, bright finish without a sugary taste. With about 60 calories per can, it’s a low-calorie choice for anyone looking for an everyday non-alcoholic beer. Vegan and gluten-reduced, Lime is made for cowboys, surfers, skaters, musicians, athletes, and creators, fitting quiet nights at home, BBQs, game days, outdoor meals, and weekend coolers. Enjoy a refreshing, easy-to-drink, subtly citrus-forward beer experience with Crazy Mountain Lime.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt—the chocolate bar that delivers the perfect combination of rich dark chocolate and a delightful crunch! Packed with 51% cocoa and whole almonds, each bite offers a perfect balance of bold, robust dark chocolate and the satisfying crunch of almonds, all beautifully enhanced by a touch of sea salt. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves the deep flavor of dark chocolate and the perfect contrast of salty and sweet! At Tony’s, we believe chocolate should be more than just a tasty indulgence—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the 51% cocoa dark chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of almonds and a touch of sea salt to elevate the flavors. Whether you’re having a sweet snack, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, the Dark Chocolate Bar with Almonds and Sea Salt is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of bold chocolate, crunchy nuts, and a hint of salt, all in one delicious, indulgent bar. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Dirty Labs is pushing an outdated industry forward. Most cleaners today use cleaning technologies that were developed almost 100 years ago. While laundry cleaning has evolved over time with some updates and improvements, deep-cleaning formulas still rely heavily on harmful, petroleum-based chemicals. Dirty Labs is different. By combining advanced enzymes and next-generation biobased ingredients, we created Phytolase, a unique, enzyme-driven cleaning technology that delivers exceptional cleaning power without toxic chemicals. Precision targeting: Each enzyme class in Phytolase is designed to target a specific type of stain. Once an enzyme finds its specific stain, it breaks that stain down into simpler component pieces that lift and rinse away. Active stain processing: After working on one stain, enzymes actively target new stains and continue breaking down more stains throughout the duration of the wash cycle. Synergistic, full-spectrum coverage: In addition to enzymes, Phytolase utilizes plant and sugar-derived surfactants to unlock additional enzyme performance and break down grease and oils. Together, they bolster each other to provide exceptional, deep cleaning on a full spectrum of tough stains. Anti-redeposition: With traditional detergents, stains can often redeposit back onto clothing and fabrics during the wash cycle. Our enzymes break down stains into water-miscible component pieces, allowing stains to lift and rinse away with your wash water. Brighter colors: Our biobased ingredients are gentler on clothing and have demonstrated better color stability and reduced color bleeding in fabrics. Phytolase also removes dirt and microfibrils that make your clothes and fabrics look dull and less vibrant—meaning newer-looking clothes that can be worn for longer.

Too many cleaners today still rely on petrochemicals and harsh synthetics that pollute the environment and our drinking water. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Have a tough job? We have an easy answer. Ultra Power Plus Seventh Generation Dish Detergent Packs feature our powerful grease-fighting formula to leave your dishes with a sparkling, streak-free shine. This dish detergent’s hardworking enzymes power away 48-hour stuck-on food, while oxygen bleach fights tough stains – all without the use of synthetic fragrances, dyes, phosphates, or chlorine bleach. Our single dose dishwasher detergent packs come in a dissolvable PVA film that can be tossed right in the dishwasher for a hassle-free alternative to traditional powders and gels – no need to unwrap or measure. Because when things get messier, you shouldn’t have to work harder. That’s our job. For more than 25 years, Seventh Generation has been thoughtfully formulating safe and effective plant-based products that work. Really well. Our dishwasher tabs use powerful plant-based ingredients like surfactants and enzymes to break down tough residue and lift away food, leaving your dishes sparkling clean. So, how does it all work? The dishwasher cleaner enzymes cut through grease and food by breaking down starch and protein-based residue, while the surfactants remove dirt and grease by holding the molecules in suspension, so they can wash away. Yes, even those fussy egg stains. Based in Vermont, Seventh Generation is proud to be a Certified B Corporation. B Corps are certified to be better for workers, better for communities, and better for the environment. By choosing Seventh Generation products, you’re joining us in nurturing the health of the next seven generations.

This formula is effective yet gentle enough for all fabrics –– even your delicates. With the added benefit of natural enzymes that penetrate the entirety of the textile fibers to neutralize stains and odors at the source, ECOS Ultra Concentrated liquid laundry detergent is the ideal choice for active families, pet owners, or those who experience skin sensitivity to conventional detergents, many of which only mask scents. ECOS Laundry Detergent is 100% Vegan and made without parabens, phosphates or dyes. Hypoallergenic, ECOS Laundry Detergent is U.S. EPA Safer Choice certified, meaning it is made without harmful ingredients and the formula is greywater and septic safe, helping keep our planet and waterways clean. Plus, each 16 oz. container offers up to 78 loads of laundry cleaning. It’s the perfect alternative to conventional detergents containing harsh chemicals and is effective on any type of fabric from delicate linens to everyday clothing. ECOS Ultra Concentrated Liquid Laundry Detergent also works great on large laundry loads and even dark colors, so you can wash with confidence and get out the toughest stains.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Frankies Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil is renowned for its exceptional quality and rich flavor. Made from hand-picked Nocellara del Belice olives grown in the sun-drenched groves of Selinunte, Sicily, this organic olive oil offers a flavor profile that is fruity, nutty, deep, and bright. Cold-pressed immediately after harvest, it preserves the natural antioxidants and nutrients of the olives, with no additives, chemicals, or preservatives. The result is a flavorful, robust oil with a smooth, peppery finish that enhances every dish, from roasted vegetables and grilled meats to soups, salads, and even vanilla ice cream. With its high smoke point and balanced taste, Frankies Extra Virgin Olive Oil is a versatile pantry staple perfect for cooking, baking, dipping, or drizzling. Crafted using time-honored methods and trusted by home cooks and chefs alike, this Frankies Extra Virgin Olive Oil represents generations of Mediterranean tradition and authenticity. Ideal for those seeking premium-quality olive oil for everyday use.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: California Olive Ranch’s globally inspired, Destination Series is a celebration of high quality high-quality extra virgin olive oil produced around the world. The olives are proudly grown and harvested by our partner growers in Argentina, Chile, Portugal, and our California farmers, and are expertly blended in California to create the ideal taste profile. This Olive Oil is made from cold-pressing olives to extract their natural oils. Other “light” or “pure” olive oil is made using excessive heat or chemicals which alter the taste and quality of the olive oil. We never use high heat or solvents in our EVOO, ensuring you get gourmet-quality. This gourmet EVOO features well-rounded tasty notes of fresh herbs, fruit and green grass. Home chefs like you use it for marinades, sautéing, roasting, grilling, frying, and even baking. Extra virgin olive oil has a wide range of flavor profiles which makes it an ideal cooking oil whether it is for a sweet or savory dish. Using olive oil as a part of your daily diet may promote heart health, lower blood pressure, and decrease your risk of diabetes. As an added bonus, our extra virgin olive oils are verified non-GMO by the Non-GMO Project, and certified kosher by Orthodox Union. They are also Whole30 approved, certified paleo, keto verified, and vegan friendly. All oils at California Olive Ranch are certified "Extra Virgin" by Applied Sensory, passing both rigid chemical and sensory evaluations. Our delicious olive oil is the only oil you need in your kitchen.

In 2004, on a mission to make a serious Zinfandel, our winemakers journeyed to Lodi in central California in search of the famed old vine Zinfandel vineyards. Grown in the head-trained, spur-pruned method for over a century, these vigorous gnarled vines produced more ripened red fruit than they had ever seen. They took it as a challenge to create the biggest, boldest Zinfandel they had ever made. The result was authentic, structured wines with a hint of something unexpected. Something Gnarly. But Zinfandel is not the only grape that can be Gnarly. Our winemakers select grapes from some of the best vineyards in Northern California to produce wines in our Gnarly house style--big and juicy. These wines are the perfect complement to life's bold moments.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: HOPWTR Blood Orange Sparkling Hop Water delivers vibrant citrus flavor paired with crisp sparkling refreshment and bold hop character in one functional non alcoholic beverage. Crafted with a brewer-approved blend of Citra, Amarillo, Mosaic, and Azacca hops, HOPWTR delivers bright citrus and pine notes balanced with juicy blood orange flavor for a refreshing sparkling drink inspired by the taste experience of your favorite IPA — without the alcohol. Unlike sugary sodas, hard seltzers, energy drinks, and non alcoholic beers loaded with calories and carbs, HOPWTR is consciously crafted with zero sugar, zero calories, zero carbs, and zero alcohol. It’s gluten free, keto friendly, and made for consumers seeking clean-label, better-for-you beverages that fit seamlessly into active and wellness-focused lifestyles. Each can is infused with functional ingredients including adaptogens and nootropics like Ashwagandha root, L-Theanine, and Reishi mushroom extract to support calm, focus, and balanced refreshment. Plus, every can contains 120% daily value of Vitamin C for added wellness support. HOPWTR is more than sparkling water or a non alcoholic beer alternative — it’s a functional sparkling beverage designed for modern drinkers who want flavor, refreshment, and feel-good ingredients in every sip. Whether you’re sober curious, participating in Dry January, cutting back on alcohol during the week, or simply searching for a healthier sparkling beverage, HOPWTR Blood Orange delivers crisp carbonation, juicy citrus flavor, and craft-inspired hop refreshment without compromise. Bright, refreshing, and positively satisfying, this is feel-good refreshment in a can.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: "Your favorite cup of Joe coffee is now available in a craft-prepared instant version—the perfect option when you’re camping, flying, on the road, or simply on the go. Processed in collaboration with our friends at Swift Cup Coffee, we meticulously roast our coffee in small batches and through Swift Cup’s proprietary process, the coffee is carefully brewed to a very flavorful concentrate before being slowly dehydrated by freeze drying. The result is a concentrated instant coffee that allows the complexity and delicate flavor profile of the roast to shine through. One of our closest producer relationships, the Guarnizo Family operates six farms in Huila, Colombia. This beautiful single-origin coffee is grown on the eastern slopes of the Central Cordillera in the Andes Mountains. Each box includes 6 individual 5g sachets of instant coffee. Simply add 8-10 oz of hot or cold water to enjoy."
