These nutrients (collagen, gelatin, amino acids, proteins) are the reason why many nutritionists recommend daily bone broth to boost the immune system as part of weight loss regimens, or as a simple way to ensure your body gets the nutrients it needs to thrive. Kettle & Fire uses only bones from organically-raised, 100% grass-fed pastured animals and all organic ingredients. Our bone broth is non-GMO, gluten-free, and contains NO hormones, antibiotics, or additives. Kettle & Fire only uses premium organic ingredients to help your body function at its best.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Give your daily wellness routine a little more staying power with KOR Immune+. This organic, cold-pressed wellness shot combines acerola cherry, pineapple, ginger, lemon, cordyceps mushroom, and astragalus root in one convenient 1.7 fl. oz. bottle. Acerola cherry is one of the richest natural sources of vitamin C, and every Immune+ shot delivers 533% of the Daily Value of vitamin C. It's a simple, convenient way to incorporate vitamin C into your everyday routine. Cordyceps mushroom and astragalus root have long histories of use in traditional wellness practices, while acerola provides a naturally vitamin C-rich foundation. Unlike capsules or powders, Immune+ is a ready-to-drink wellness shot made with real fruits and roots. KOR cold presses and mixes its juices in small batches in Southern California and uses High Pressure Processing (HPP) rather than high heat to maintain freshness and deliver incredible taste. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Meet Crave Reset Fiber Drinks: Your Prebiotic Answer to Everyday Cravings. Kuli Kuli Crave Reset is an organic, tropical pineapple greens superfood powder drink mix built around one job: helping you feel full and satisfied between meals, so a craving doesn't derail your day. Each 2.5 tsp scoop (15 servings per pouch) delivers 6g of prebiotic fiber (21% Daily Value) from organic Jerusalem artichoke, plus 480mg organic moringa and 240mg organic spirulina, at just 30 calories and 1g sugar. What's Inside: Organic Inulin Extract Powder from Jerusalem Artichoke (a prebiotic fiber that feeds the good bacteria in your gut), Organic Moringa Oleifera Leaf Powder (a leafy green superfood bursting with essential nutrients), Organic Spirulina Powder (an algae filled with protein, antioxidants, and B vitamins), and Organic Pineapple Powder (rich in Vitamin C and bromelain, and the source of this drink's natural sweetness), plus Citric Acid and a touch of Organic Monk Fruit Extract. No artificial sweeteners, colors, or flavors, ever. Why You'll Love It: Helps you feel fuller longer between meals; 6g prebiotic fiber (21% DV) in every scoop; USDA Organic, vegan, gluten-free, non-GMO, and caffeine-free; naturally sweetened with real pineapple and organic monk fruit; easy to mix, no blender required. How to Enjoy: Mix 2.5 tsp with 8oz of cold or iced water, sparkling water, coconut water, or your favorite smoothie. For the smoothest texture, shake it in a bottle rather than just stirring, since fine superfood powders can settle. Enjoy between meals, in the afternoon, or anytime a craving strikes. About Kuli Kuli: A certified B Corporation and women-owned small business, Kuli Kuli sources its superfoods directly from smallholder farms around the world, on a mission to nourish people and the planet, one scoop at a time.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Elevate your daily beauty and wellness routine with Kuli Kuli Sea Moss & Blue Spirulina Superfood Gummies, a short, clean ingredient list built for shoppers who already care for their skin and want the same support from the inside out. Each Pineapple Colada gummy pairs 120 mg organic Irish sea moss, a mineral-rich ocean seaweed, with 69 mg organic baobab, 10 mg organic blue spirulina, 4 mg organic kelp, and vitamin C, feeding your skin's natural hydration and glow while supporting a healthy immune system, your body's own collagen production, and your resilience to everyday stress. They are 100% vegan, gelatin-free, Non-GMO Project Verified, made with no gluten-containing ingredients, and third-party tested for quality and purity, so this herbal supplement's vitamins and minerals are checked before they reach you. If you are pregnant, nursing, or managing a medical condition, consult your healthcare professional before use. Kuli Kuli is a Certified B Corporation and women-owned small business, sourcing organic, climate-smart plants in collaboration with small farming communities since 2014. This Skin Glow & Immune Function flavor is one of six distinct Kuli Kuli gummy formulas, each built around its own goal, so you can pick the one that matches yours, whether that's beauty, energy, or gut health. Caffeine-free and made with over 25% recycled packaging, these gummies make nourishing your skin, your immunity, and the planet simple, enjoyable, and genuinely tasty, one small, sustainable habit at a time.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Ever been caught in a diurnal swing? We’ll walk you through it. It’s summer in California's Central Valley. The sun is high and hot. Come nightfall, it’s jacket weather. That’s the swing, but the olive trees thrive by outsmarting the elements. During the dips, Arbequina and Koroneiki olive trees overproduce polyphenols to protect their precious fruit from California’s shifting climate. By autumn, the sun-drenched olives are brimming with antioxidants and ready for early harvest. After the picking, it’s really a matter of hours before the olives are cold pressed. When the entire journey is local, it’s natural for things to run smoothly. Ironically, this olive oil is Rich & Robust, like sunshine in a bottle. La Tourangelle’s California Extra Virgin Olive Oil is a testament to our growing legacy in Woodland, California, where we've been practicing our family tradition of artisan oil-making since 2002. P.S. In France since 1867.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: As artisan oil makers since 1867, we know the best ingredients begin with healthy soil. Regenerative farmers know this too. As a philosophy, regenerative agriculture focuses on actively working to improve the health of the land, down to the microbes in the soil. It’s an approach that requires listening. By cultivating a deep understanding of the land, farmers are able to determine what it needs to thrive. When you work with the land rather than against it, everything works together the way nature intended. La Tourangelle’s Regenerative Extra Virgin Olive Oil is made using Certified Regenerative, early harvest Koroneiki olives from Peloponnese, a Greek region known for producing small, high-density fruit. This olive oil is special, carrying a distinct sensory signature from its Mediterranean homeland. Green, vibrant, and zesty—with a peppery kick you’d expect from a highly phenolic, antioxidant-rich olive oil. Bursting with flavor and freshness, our Regenerative Extra Virgin Olive Oil is a testament to our deep reverence for sustainable agriculture and our commitment to seeking out and partnering with farmers who nurture the land for today and generations to come.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Crafted with the same premium ingredients that define our renowned IPAs—hops, malt, yeast, and water—this Non-Alcoholic IPA promises the same level of delectable flavor without the need for arcane rituals or ancient incantations that typically push it over the edge. With an alcohol content of just under 0.5%, this brew retains the essence of its alcoholic counterparts while offering a refreshing alternative. Featuring a bold combina-tion of Citra, Mosaic, and CTZ (Columbus, Tomahawk, & Zeus) hops sourced from Ya-kima Valley, this IPA boasts a dank and piney profile, enhanced by a massive dry-hop process. Nestled atop a foundation of English crystal malts, it delivers a smooth back-bone and stunning orange hue, culminating in a uniquely full-bodied experience with an intoxicatingly hoppy aroma that is sure to please. Prepare your senses for a journey through layers of flavor as you indulge in IPNA's sat-isfyingly robust body and captivating hoppy aroma. This non-alcoholic offering show-cases the versatility of hops, presenting an almost tea-like herbal note that adds depth and complexity to every sip. While aroma alone cannot convey tartness, your olfactory senses may deceive you with the illusion of strong lemon zest notes, tantalizing your taste buds and leaving your mouth watering for more. Dive into a world of flavor without compromise with IPNA, where every sip promises a delightful exploration of hoppy richness and unparalleled satisfaction.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Lumineux is the first truly ethical oral care company to emerge on the market in close to a century. Founded on decades of international research conducted by two world-renowned dentists, our products have a back-to-basics approach that use naturally occurring ingredients like Dead Sea salt, aloe vera juice and potent essential oils to handle the source of bad breath, decay and disease without cumulative side-effects, and unnecessary additives. Lumineux is the first oral care product to protect the oral micro biome and neutralize the toxins of bad bacteria, rather than indiscriminately killing bacteria. The result is a clean, non-toxic, and proven effective line of solutions that are backed by clinical and in-the-field studies that are truly head and shoulders above what’s available to consumers. Dr. Kourosh Maddahi, Lumineux’s Founder and CEO, puts it perfectly, saying, “You shouldn’t have to choose between a product that’s good for you, and a product that actually works.” Lumineux remains the only oral care line to carry the Made Safe certification, as well as Non- Toxic certification for all its products from the LEMI Lab in France, and head-to-head clinical studies against every leading brand from the University of Irvine, California.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Hemp Hearts are versatile seeds that will add nutrition and a rich nutty taste to any meal! Shelling the hemp seed produces the most nutritious and tender part of the seed, the heart. Hemp Hearts taste great, are easy to use, and nutritious too! There’s no need to grind or cook Hemp Hearts, they’re ready to eat straight from the bag and are simple to incorporate into your diet. Try sprinkling them on salads, cereal, or yogurt or blend them into smoothies. Hemp Hearts may look little, but they contain 10 grams of Plant Based Protein and 10 grams of Omega-3 and Omega-6 per 30 gram serving (more than a comparable serving of flax or chia). We know how to unlock the power of the hemp seed better than anyone because we take a seed-to-shelf approach, controlling the quality in everything from what hemp seed gets planted to how products are manufactured, packaged, and distributed. Our producer partners deliver whole seed directly to our state-of-the-art, BRC (the highest level of food safety and quality certification in the world) certified facility. Hemp Hearts, as with all Manitoba Harvest products, is Non-GMO Project Verified.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Keep your baby’s skin clean, fresh, and protected with Millie Moon Sensitive Wipes, specially designed for delicate and sensitive skin. This value pack includes 648 ultra-soft wipes made with a 99% natural formula that helps gently cleanse while supporting your little one’s skin health. Dermatologist tested and hypoallergenic, these wipes are crafted to provide a gentle cleaning experience without harsh ingredients, making them ideal for everyday diaper changes, mealtime cleanups, and on-the-go messes. Enriched with soothing botanical extracts including aloe, avocado, and marigold, Millie Moon Sensitive Wipes help comfort and protect delicate skin while maintaining a balanced moisture level. The pH-balanced formula is fragrance-free, lotion-free, alcohol-free, and latex-free, reducing the risk of irritation for babies with sensitive skin. Made from plant-based, plastic-free cloth, these wipes offer a more thoughtful alternative while remaining soft, durable, and effective. The premium embossed texture is designed to capture and lift messes more efficiently, allowing for a thorough clean with fewer wipes. Each wipe dispenses smoothly for added convenience, helping parents handle diaper changes quickly and easily. Whether you're caring for a newborn, infant, or toddler, these wipes deliver dependable performance while remaining gentle on delicate skin. Perfect for nurseries, diaper bags, daycare supplies, and everyday family use, Millie Moon Sensitive Wipes provide a combination of softness, convenience, and trusted care. With 648 wipes per pack, you'll have a long-lasting supply ready whenever life's little messes happen. Choose Millie Moon Sensitive Wipes for a gentle, effective clean that parents can feel confident using every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Provide your baby with exceptional comfort and dependable protection with Millie Moon Luxury Diapers, Size 3. Designed for babies weighing 13–24 lbs (6–11 kg), these premium diapers combine advanced absorbency with an incredibly soft feel to help keep your little one comfortable throughout the day and night. This convenient pack includes 27 diapers, making it an ideal choice for home use, travel, daycare, or keeping extra supplies on hand. Featuring Millie Moon’s signature CloudTouch Softness, these diapers are crafted with high-quality materials that feel gentle against delicate skin. Dermatologist tested and hypoallergenic, they are thoughtfully designed to support babies with sensitive skin while helping reduce discomfort associated with wetness and friction. The breathable construction promotes airflow to help maintain a comfortable environment for your baby during active play, naps, and overnight sleep. The highly absorbent core is engineered to quickly lock away moisture, helping keep skin drier for longer periods. Advanced leak protection features, including soft leg cuffs and a secure waistband, help provide a comfortable fit while reducing the risk of leaks. The flexible design moves with your baby, allowing freedom of movement as they crawl, explore, and grow. Free from added lotions, fragrances, and elemental chlorine bleaching, Millie Moon Luxury Diapers are created with a focus on gentle care and trusted performance. The contoured shape delivers a snug yet comfortable fit that adapts to your baby’s natural movements without feeling restrictive. Perfect for busy parents seeking premium-quality diapering essentials, Millie Moon Size 3 Diapers offer a balance of softness, absorbency, and leak protection. Whether used during the day or overnight, these diapers help provide lasting comfort and dependable dryness. With 27 diapers included in each pack, you can enjoy the trusted quality of Millie Moon while keeping your baby clean, comfortable, and protected every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Modelo Spiked Aguas Frescas Variety Pack includes 12 slim cans of fruit-forward, flavored malt beverages, featuring three canned drinks each of Piña (Pineapple), Sandía (Watermelon), Pepino y Limón (Cucumber Lime), and Flor de Jamaica (Hibiscus) flavors. Inspired by the refreshing fruit taste of classic aguas frescas found in the street markets of Mexico, the lightly spiked, ready to drink beverages in this canned drinks 12 pack offer an authentic twist on the classic Mexican drink. With fewer than 200 calories* per slim can, these fruit-flavored malt drinks are made with a splash of real fruit juice** and no artificial sweeteners or artificial flavors, staying true to traditional Mexican aguas frescas recipes by delivering a lightly carbonated, full-flavored taste experience. Piña offers the pleasing aroma and balanced flavor of sweet and juicy pineapple, Sandía features the indulgently sweet taste of watermelon, Pepino y Limón offers the fresh taste of cucumber balanced by lime sweetness, and Flor de Jamaica features sweet floral and fruity notes with a touch of sourness. Each sip of these lightly sweet drinks delivers a boldly authentic, vibrantly flavorful drinking experience that is especially enjoyable on a warm day. Another premium offering from the Modelo beer family, these Modelo Spiked Aguas Frescas premixed drinks are perfect served at a backyard barbecue or poured into glasses to enjoy with a special meal. *Not a low-calorie food. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Meet your new favorite strawberry soda. Berry iconic, dreamier than ever. Strawberry Cream blends the flavor of ripe strawberry with real, smooth vanilla extract for a sip that’s creamy and refreshing — no sugar, no guilt! This organic zero sugar soda delivers indulgent flavor with zero calories and all the nostalgia. Founded by organic food pioneer Nicole Dawes, founder of Late July Snacks, Nixie was created to prove that better for you soda can taste just as good as the classics. Made with USDA Certified Organic flavors and real vanilla extract, Nixie Strawberry Cream brings together fruitiness and creamy smoothness without artificial sweeteners or colors. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Elevate your home cooking with our Organic Mushroom Dashi, a rich, plant-based foundation inspired by the traditions of Japanese cuisine. Just as a Western chef reaches for a flavorful vegetable stock, Japanese cooks rely on dashi to create depth, balance, and savory complexity in countless dishes. Whether you're building a comforting bowl of miso soup, preparing a hearty hot pot, or adding umami richness to everyday recipes, this ready-to-use broth saves you hours of prep time while delivering authentic flavor. Simply shake well, pour, and bring restaurant-quality taste to your kitchen. Crafted with organic mushrooms and nourishing kelp, this vegan dashi delivers a deep, earthy umami character with layers of savory flavor that powder concentrates simply can't match. The combination creates a smooth, well-rounded broth that enhances everything from traditional Japanese dishes to modern plant-based cooking, making it an indispensable pantry staple for home chefs and culinary enthusiasts alike.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Nutiva Organic Liquid Coconut Oil is rich in MCTs, making it a nourishing and versatile great food for cooking, baking, and beauty. Unlike other oils on the market, Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil is never processed using hexane or other dangerous chemicals. At Nutiva, we start with organic, non-GMO Southeast Asian coconuts, sustainably harvested and immediately cold pressed to naturally extract the fresh, flavorful coconut oil. Next, Nutiva uses a USDA certified organic process to extract the fats from the virgin coconut oil that remain solid at room temperature, resulting in an oil that remains liquid, even at cooler temperatures. The neutral flavor makes it great for sautéing, baking, or enhancing your favorite recipes. It's ideal as a medium-heat cooking oil, a nutritious substitute in baking and is an excellent alternative to olive oil. It’s also a wholesome addition to vegetarian, vegan, raw, whole food, paleo-friendly, ketogenic, and gluten-free diets. The purity and nutrient density of Nutiva’s Liquid Coconut Oil make it good for you both inside and out. Use the luscious, soothing oil as a natural skin moisturizer, eye make-up remover, deep conditioning hair treatment, or combine it with Nutiva Coconut Sugar and your favorite essential oil for an exfoliating, refreshing body scrub. Nutiva was founded in 1999 with a single purpose in mind - to Revolutionize the Way the World Eats. We produce organic, nutrient-dense foods that are good for you and good for the planet. Social and environmental responsibility is a core part of Nutiva’s culture and business. We are dedicated to sourcing organic products, obtaining fair trade certification, greening our facilities and operations, and funding tree planting at schools in our local community; we are constantly seeking ways to better protect our environment and ensure a better quality of life for employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: For over a decade, co-founders, Ben and David have shared a vision of a tastier future. Their quest for a product that could undermine the old guard of soda behemoths led them to OLIPOP: a thoughtfully crafted tonic that found its taste in wholesome, hardworking ingredients instead of spoonfuls of sugar. So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Slippery Elm Bark, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

So, why a prebiotic soda? OLIPOP assembled a global team of leading microbiome research pioneers and doctors to help them develop this functional beverage with cutting edge research. OLIPOP's natural ingredients—such as Marshmallow Root, Chicory Root, Calendula, Slippery Elm Bark, Nopal Cactus, Cassava Root, Kudzu Root, and Jerusalem Artichoke—work together to promote digestion by feeding the microbiome that exists within all of us. Essentially, our beverages contain plant fibers that stimulate the growth of bacteria in your gut, which improves overall digestion. Our combination of plant fiber, prebiotics, and botanicals creates a sweet taste that even a sugar-loaded soda can't compete with. Enjoy our range of sparkling tonics in 6 delicious, soda-style flavors: Vintage Cola, Strawberry Vanilla, Classic Root Beer, Orange Squeeze, Cherry Vanilla, and Ginger Lemon. Our prebiotic soft drinks contain 9g of dietary fiber and 2-5g of sugar. Each pop is under 50 calories, non-GMO, vegan, gluten-free, Paleo, and Keto-friendly with NO artificial sweeteners, colors, flavors, preservatives, or ingredients. Remember, life is too short not to enjoy it—and too long to spoil it. Soda is a shortcut with no long term benefits. OLIPOP is an off-ramp to a delicious experience. Please Note: Refrigerate upon arrival. FDA Disclaimer: These statements have not been evaluated by the Food and Drug Administration. This product is not intended to diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: An organic baby food variety pack pre-picked with our favorite, top selling purees, in one convenient bundle ideal for introducing solids into your little ones’ diet! This pack contains four Baby Fruit & Veggie blends suitable for ages 6+ months in a 4-pack. Proud recipient of The Clean Label Project verification and Purity Award Certification, parents will feel confident feeding their little ones these delicious blends. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Roasted Red Pepper and Tomato Soup. This USDA Organic soup is consciously crafted with non-GMO ingredients, including vine-ripened tomatoes and real cream. Roasted red bell peppers add a hint of smoky sweetness, creating a flavorful vegetarian soup that satisfies with every spoonful. Providing 1/3 cup of vegetables per serving, this gluten free soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy vegetarian snack, customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a salad, sandwich, or wrap. You can also use it to create flavorful sauces or as a base for your favorite side dish. Each 32 oz resealable carton contains about 4 servings of organic tomato soup. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Butter Chicken and Rice Soup. Ginger, turmeric and other seasonings round out the flavor of this soup, bringing a classic recipe to a whole new level of goodness. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings or pair soups with a salad, sandwich or wrap. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Butternut Squash Soup With Cinnamon and Nutmeg. Free from high fructose corn syrup and artificial colors, this gluten free soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy vegetarian snack, customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a salad, sandwich or wrap. You can also use it to create flavorful sauces or as a base for your favorite side dish. To prepare, simply pour, heat until hot, stir and enjoy. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Experience layers of nourishing flavor with Pacific Foods Organic Free Range Chicken Broth. We slow-simmer organic free-range chicken with sea salt and seasonings for a savory organic chicken broth that's rich and full of flavor. Sip a cup of warm chicken broth instead of coffee or tea for a delicious, satisfying addition to your everyday routine. It's great for refueling after workouts, beating the afternoon slump, or relaxing in the evening. Just pour, heat and enjoy! For an even better sipping experience, add a slice of lemon, ginger or some fresh herbs to your gluten free broth. Our USDA Certified Organic broth is made from non-GMO ingredients and free of gluten and fat.(1) It may also be suitable for keto diets. Each 1-cup serving of Pacific Foods Organic Broth contains less than 1 gram of carbs and 10 calories. One 32 oz recyclable carton contains roughly 4 servings. In addition to drinking it as a traditional sipping broth, you can use this broth in any recipe that calls for chicken stock, organic bone broth or water, such as homemade soups. Try it as a soup base or to cook veggies. (1) See nutrition facts for sodium content

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Curry Potato and Vegetable Soup. With no added sugars and no high fructose corn syrup, this plant-based, vegan soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Enjoy the gluten free soup on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a salad, sandwich, or wrap. To prepare the canned soup, simply microwave on high for 2.5 to 3 minutes, or heat in a saucepan on the stove, stirring occasionally. Each 16.3 oz recyclable can contains two cups of microwave soup. In addition to Organic Curry Potato and Vegetable Soup, Pacific Foods offers Hearty Vegetable, Tomato Bisque, and more. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Enjoy a refined take on a classic comfort food with Pacific Foods Organic Condensed Tomato Soup. Rich and savory, this USDA Organic soup is consciously crafted with non-GMO ingredients, including Regenerative Organic Certified tomato paste and sea salt. Regenerative Organic Certified ingredients like the tomato paste in this canned soup build upon USDA Organic standards with an extra focus on soil health, land management, and farmer and worker fairness. Free from high fructose corn syrup, artificial flavors, and artificial colors, this gluten free and vegan soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Savor a warm bowl of organic tomato soup on its own, topped with fresh basil, or paired with a grilled cheese sandwich. You can also use it as an ingredient in recipes like casseroles, sauces, and hearty chilis and stews, elevating every bite with rich, organic flavor. To prepare, simply mix the condensed soup with 1 can of water and microwave on high for 2.5 to 3 minutes, or heat in a saucepan on the stove, stirring occasionally. Each 10.75 oz recyclable can contains about 2.5 servings of microwave soup.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Our story began in Williamsburg, Brooklyn, in 2012 with two childhood friends who wanted to create a place to celebrate coffee. At the core, we started with a commitment to source coffee through lasting relationships and roast quality coffee that highlights those as they should be. We opened our flagship roastery, education lab, and cafe on North 6th Street to create a space for coffee that is fun, approachable, and social. As our community grew, we did too: new spaces, new partners, new food, new relationships at origin, and of course, new coffee. Since then, our partnerships with farmers, producers, baristas, roasters, businesses, and customers have helped us to grow and nurture a shared coffee culture and experience in the city and beyond. We believe that we’re only as great as the sum of our partners. As partners in coffee, we thank you for being part of our journey, shaping our community, and helping us become who we are today. Partners Coffee is built on the strength of our lasting relationships at origin. We source coffee from around the world from people we know and trust—to produce beautiful coffee, and be the greatest stewards of the land they grow upon. We focus on relationships. We aspire to purchase from the same producers and communities year after year and to work directly with producers when possible. Our goal is to promote mutual, long-term success through communication and shared growth. Maintaining strong relationships at origin allows Partners to offer blends with a consistent flavor profile while celebrating talented producers through their seasonally rotating single origin menu. We believe in comprehensive purchasing. Even the best coffee farms produce a spectrum of quality. We consider this and strategize large, meaningful purchases—where we buy microlots and seek dependable volume coffees. Through the careful purchasing of non-commodity priced coffee, Partners builds secure supply chains that enable farmers to invest in local communities.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Pedro Ximénez White Wine Vinegar brings together rich sweetness and traditional Spanish craftsmanship in a refined gourmet condiment. Made from Pedro Ximénez wine, this semi-sweet vinegar delivers depth, balance, and a smooth, velvety finish that enhances everyday cooking. Designed for versatility, it adds complexity to both simple and elaborate dishes. The naturally balanced sweet-acid profile features subtle caramelized notes without added sugar, making it suitable for a wide range of recipes that require depth without overpowering other ingredients. The aromatic profile reveals layers of caramel, oak, and classic PX wine notes. On the palate, it offers a velvety texture with raisin and honey nuances, followed by a long, smooth finish that complements both savory and sweet applications. Ideal for culinary use, it works well in glazes and reductions for meats, enhancing flavor with a rich, balanced profile. It can be used in salad dressings, especially when paired with aged cheeses, or drizzled over roasted vegetables to add depth. Its unique flavor also pairs well with desserts such as strawberries, vanilla ice cream, and chocolate-based dishes. For best results, use in small amounts to build flavor gradually. Store in a cool, dry place and keep sealed to preserve aroma and taste over time. This gourmet vinegar offers a refined way to elevate daily meals with authentic Spanish character and a smooth, well-rounded flavor profile.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: “On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It’s visceral." Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Some have described Alfred Peet as the “big bang” of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America’s expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet’s pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason’s one-of-a-kind taste, you’ll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason’s but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It’s the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Great coffee brings friends and neighbors together like nothing else. That's why we created this medium roast to pay tribute to the time-honored pastime of lingering in the café, casually sipping an expertly brewed cup over conversation. The three Latin American coffees in this carefully crafted blend were selected for their balance and brightness, and the roast fine-tuned to brew the perfect medium-bodied cup. We decided to name it after our third café, opened by Alfred Peet in 1980 on Domingo Avenue in Berkeley, in the shadow of the Claremont Hotel. For more than three decades, Peet's regulars have gathered here to enjoy hand-crafted drinks and the camaraderie they inspire. And that's something worth commemorating. Our pods are compatible with all single serve brewers.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Colombia Dark Roast Coffee is for those seeking exceptional, full-bodied Colombian coffee, shining and sweet from the rarest lots. Colombia is synonymous with good coffee, and the country produces more washed Arabica beans than any other. But while the overall quality is consistent and familiar to the American palate, Colombia also produces exceptional coffees from specific micro-climates. Not one but three cordilleras traverse this enormous, emerald country and the variety of sun and rain regimes mean that harvesting is going on somewhere almost throughout the year. As always, we select by the cup, seeking the rarest lots of the brightest, sweetest, most exceptional beans. Our favorite, flavorful, full-bodied Colombian coffee comes from the heights of the remote southern province of Huila, a region that still grows the traditional typica beans along with the newer varieties. At the massif of two ranges, and the headwaters of a river that flows 950 miles north to the Caribbean, a small group of growers produce a shining, sweet and delicately fruited Colombia that has a taste unto its own.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: For a decaf version of the best loved Peet's Coffee to earn the Major Dickason's name, we felt it had to brew the absolute finest decaf cup in the world. So we used the exact same premium beans as the original to create a blend just as full of flavor, body, and aroma, but without any caffeine. The mellow, satisfying richness stands alone among decafs, whether prepared in a press, by drip, or as espresso. It's the boldest of its kind. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The signature taste and rich coffee character of Peet's French Roast Dark Roast Coffee comes from a longer, hotter roast, which not all beans can handle. For our darkest roast, we select only top-quality Arabica coffee from the highest altitudes of prime Latin American growing regions. Beans mature slowly at these altitudes, becoming denser, harder and packed with flavor, perfect for retaining boldness and complexity under the intense heat of a deep roast. Peet's French Roast is not a coffee for the cautious, but for those who embrace the powerful taste, pronounced smoky overtones, and pleasant bite. This dark, deeply flavorful blend pairs well with cream and sugar, and inspires reactions like this one from John "Nic" Nicolini, a Peet's roaster for over 20 years: �On a normal day, I cup 50 coffees before 7 a.m. But I always come back to French. You inhale that smoky aroma, and then a subtle sweetness pops out that awakens your taste buds. It's visceral."

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's French Roast encompasses our favorite beans for this deepest roast. These beans are from the leading Latin American origins, such as Guatemala and Colombia, where high altitudes enable coffee cherry to mature more slowly, becoming denser, harder, and packed with flavor. These inherently bright, juicy beans retain their bold complexity under the heat of a deep roast. To grow organic coffee is a commitment to environmental stewardship despite an inevitably smaller yield. Where conventional farming benefits from carefully formulated nutrients, organic farming is local and labor intensive, with resources like natural compost, fashioned on the farm. It's more work to produce less coffee and we're happy to support the extra effort. Enjoy this meticulously grown, deep-roasted coffee that is a bold dedication to flavor, farm, and future.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Ever since Alfred Peet opened the doors of his first small Berkeley shop in 1966, Peet's has been known as a pioneer of fine, distinctive coffees high-grown, higher quality, and deeply roasted to maximize flavor. Peet's House Blend Dark Roast Coffee is a perfect introduction to our signature style. First crafted by Mr. Peet, this blend of carefully selected, choice beans from our favorite Latin American origins brews a cup that's uniquely rich and approachable, with a pleasant spiciness. It's deep-roasted by hand in small batches to impart the most flavor and aroma. And like all our coffees, it's delivered unimaginably fresh. Bright, balanced flavors and medium body make House Blend inviting and easy to love. Mr. Peet used to call it a "starter coffee, recommending it to new customers as their "intro" to the Peet's style. And more than five decades later, Peetniks everywhere are still at home with House.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Organic French Roast encompasses our favorite beans for this deepest roast. These beans are from the leading Latin American origins, such as Guatemala and Colombia, where high altitudes enable coffee cherry to mature more slowly, becoming denser, harder, and packed with flavor. These inherently bright, juicy beans retain their bold complexity under the heat of a deep roast. To grow organic coffee is a commitment to environmental stewardship despite an inevitably smaller yield. Where conventional farming benefits from carefully formulated nutrients, organic farming is local and labor intensive, with resources like natural compost, fashioned on the farm. It's more work to produce less coffee and we're happy to support the extra effort. Enjoy this meticulously grown, deep-roasted coffee that is a bold dedication to flavor, farm, and future.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Single Origin Sumatra Dark Roast Coffee, perhaps the quintessential Indonesian coffee, doesn't grow on estates or big farms. It comes from the backyards and garden plots of small landholders, who often have only a few trees and process beans by hand, using the semi-washed method, that could be the secret to this coffee's unconstrained flavor and hefty, syrup-like body. Cherries are pulped on the farm with a hand-cranked mill, and the seeds hand washed in a basket. Collectors purchase and hull the coffee while still moist and dark grayish-green, removing the parchment shells and allowing the beans to sun-dry only briefly before delivering them to the port of Medan. Along the way, they become fully dry in stages�acquiring their characteristic Sumatran earthiness and complexity. Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. We sample exhaustively for every lot we select, looking for the most exceptional body and sweet herbal nuances to coax out with our signature Peet's roast. The result is a gutsy, glorious coffee that brews a richly seductive cup.

Because each lot might include the beans of 100 different farmers, great Sumatra relies on strong relationships and sharp tasting skills. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In Colombia, luminosa means "shining or bright". Peet's Luminosa Breakfast Blend Light Roast Coffee layers subtle sweetness from Colombia with just the right touch of Ethiopia floral aromatics, a pair we knew would go perfectly together. We started with a coffee from the Huila region in Colombia's highlands, a place where beans are cultivated over 4,500 feet and known for their smooth, sweet character. Then to Ethiopia, coffee's birthplace, where unique varieties yield exquisite coffees with delicate aromas. Formerly known as Colombia Luminosa, we approached this bright blend, our first light roast, as we do all our coffees: carefully select the very best beans, then hand roast them in small batches to achieve their utmost flavor.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Big Bang Medium Roast Coffee is our signature medium roast created to celebrate Alfred Peet and our 50th anniversary. Some have described Alfred Peet as the "big bang" of craft coffee, the one who started it all. When he set up shop in Berkeley back in 1966, he transformed America's expectations of the depth, body, and flavor in our cups. And that pursuit of greatness has never stopped. In 2016, we honored his legacy by taking a bold step ahead. Like Mr. Peet's pioneering dark roasts, this blend expands the horizon of what coffee can be: vibrant, full-flavored, boldly original, and roasted to medium-bodied perfection. If you love Major Dickason's one-of-a-kind taste, you'll find a kindred spirit in Big Bang. This blend is crafted from some of the same premium coffees as Major Dickason's but with a twist, thanks to the heavenly, aromatic citrus of Ethiopian Super Natural. It's the perfect coffee to honor the man who still inspires us every day.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: A smooth medium-bodied cup with subtle notes of sweet citrus and bittersweet chocolate. Everything we love in the fine coffees grown in this part of the world. The coffee hails from high elevation organic farms across the Americas, from Guatemala to Colombia, where superior terroir and carefully honed growing practices create some of the best beans in the world. Organic farmers in this region are committed to preserving the beauty and richness of the land that is both their home and livelihood. Alma de la Tierra, or "Soul of the Earth", honors this worthy intention and the hard work required to realize it.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Organic French Roast encompasses our favorite beans for this deepest roast. These beans are from the leading Latin American origins, such as Guatemala and Colombia, where high altitudes enable coffee cherry to mature more slowly, becoming denser, harder, and packed with flavor. These inherently bright, juicy beans retain their bold complexity under the heat of a deep roast. To grow organic coffee is a commitment to environmental stewardship despite an inevitably smaller yield. Where conventional farming benefits from carefully formulated nutrients, organic farming is local and labor intensive, with resources like natural compost, fashioned on the farm. It's more work to produce less coffee and we're happy to support the extra effort. Enjoy this meticulously grown, deep-roasted coffee that is a bold dedication to flavor, farm, and future.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Peet's Major Dickason's Blend Dark Roast Coffee is the roast that put Peet's Coffee on the map. A loyal customer of our original Berkeley store, retired army sergeant Key Dickason, brought the idea for our most beloved blend to Mr. Peet in 1969. Intrigued, our founder worked with the local gourmand and coffee aficionado to refine it. They sampled countless combinations before arriving at what is now our all-time bestseller. The result was so good, Alfred Peet decided naming it after his friend wasn't enough. Dickason's rich, complex blend also deserved a promotion from sergeant to major. Major Dickason's combines the best origin coffees from the world's premier growing regions, each imparting its distinctive regional characteristics while still effortlessly rounding into a smooth, balanced cup. Over the years, it has become the coffee that epitomizes Peet's: flavorful, deeply roasted, and unsurpassingly satisfying. But for us, "Major D" is just like a relationship with an old friend. We'll always remember it as the story of a customer's passion, an expert's palate, and a shared love of coffee.

Just quality ingredients for a quality feeling. Because real food deserves freshness, you'll store Oaties in the fridge right alongside your other real, whole-food staples to maintain their signature soft bite. Need to take them on the go? Oaties stay fresh outside the fridge for up to 7 days - always ready for you, even when life gets busy. Organic. Non-GMO. Gluten-free. Low glycemic. Kosher. Packed with prebiotic fiber. Protein that tastes like a treat but delivers everything your body actually needs. Perfect Bar Oaties are what your mind, body, and taste buds deserve.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: An excellent source of protein, deliciously smooth and creamy Koia Plant Protein Drink is ideal as a quick, on-the-go breakfast, post-workout boost, or afternoon snack. The crave able Cold Brew Coffee ready-to-drink beverage powers your day with a high protein-to-sugar ratio - 18 grams of plant-powered protein and only 4 grams of sugar. Starting with an almond milk base, Koia blends in a proprietary mix of brown rice, pea, and hemp proteins, then adds a touch of organic cane sugar and monk fruit to deliver the positive power of plants without adding the things you usually see - like tons of sugar or artificial ingredients. A great fit for healthy, active lifestyles, Koia beverages are vegan, free of soy, dairy, and gluten, high in fiber, Kosher, and non-GMO. Koia Cold Brew Coffee has 170 calories, 5 grams of fat, and 5 grams of fiber (13 grams of total carbohydrates). Ready to go wherever you roam, Koia is also a great addition to your morning coffee as a creamer substitute. Our pasta is then dried low and slow, a time‑honored method that ensures our 2-ingredient recipe has a consistently firm, perfectly al dente texture. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Bring home the famous taste of Rao’s Homemade Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce. Rao’s Homemade Sauce is a premium, carb conscious pasta sauce made with only the finest ingredients. Delicious speaks for itself when enjoying this tomato sauce. Rao’s has combined what you love about their famous marinara sauce with fresh basil to create a pasta sauce that is packed with flavor and versatility. Each batch of Rao’s Homemade Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce is slow-cooked in small batches with high quality ingredients. These wholesome ingredients blend Italian tomatoes, olive oil, and onions with fresh basil, fresh garlic, oregano, black pepper and salt creating a pasta sauce that brings back memories of family dinners around the table. Rao’s Tomato Basil Pasta Sauce recipe stays true to its classic Italian roots making it the perfect carb conscious pasta sauce. Rao’s Homemade Tomato Basil sauce has no added sugar* making it a keto friendly pasta sauce you’ll want in your pantry. This premium pasta sauce tastes delicious, and is made with the finest ingredients, without any tomato blends, tomato paste, water, starches, added colors, or sugar. Rao’s Homemade, originally born in New York, now brings authentic Italian flavor into your home. Rao’s Tomato Basil pasta sauce is a versatile carb conscious pasta sauce that offers truly traditional homemade Italian flavor, easily available anytime to pair with your preferred pasta, to use as an ingredient in your favorite recipe, or to accompany your favorite meatballs. *Not a low or reduced calorie food, see nutrition panel for further information on Sugar and Calorie content

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: An unexpected yet artful wine, Saldo Zinfandel Red Wine by The Prisoner Wine Company offers dense concentration of flavor backed by good acidity. This red California wine features outstanding fruit from premier Northern California vineyards in the Dry Creek, Lodi, and Amador regions, where zinfandel grapes have thrived for decades. Made with a mix of zinfandel, petite sirah, and syrah red grapes masterfully welded together with love and precision, this bottle of red wine opens with intriguing and bold aromas of black licorice, black pepper, cherry, and baking spice. Each mouthwatering sip of this dark red wine is rich, full, and scintillating, with a hint of chocolate, leading to a smooth, voluptuous finish with soft, velvety tannins. Barrel aging in a combination of old and new, French and American oak barrels brings out the full flavors of this delicious red wine, adding to its exquisitely smooth palate. A food-friendly wine, this Saldo zinfandel wine pairs well with grilled steaks, aged cheddar or provolone, pasta with red sauce, charcuterie, and a variety of spicy dishes. For best taste, store this 750 mL bottle of wine at room temperature but chill for at least 30 minutes before serving. Please enjoy our wines responsibly. 2021 The Prisoner Wine Company, Oakville, CA

These three things always come back together around a big bowl of delicious Late July tortilla chips and a jar of our mild organic salsa. Each 15.5 oz jar of red salsa offers about 14 servings, perfect for sharing with family and friends. Elevate your taco dip, breakfast burritos and other favorites with our gluten free tomato salsa. It also makes the perfect addition to your favorite recipes, from chicken flautas to huevos rancheros. We care deeply about using the highest quality organic and non-GMO ingredients with no artificial flavors or preservatives, so you can enjoy snacks that are simple, pure and good. Handcrafted in small batches, this gourmet 5 oz salami chub infuses premium pork with real aged Pecorino Romano cheese and freshly toasted, coarsely cracked black peppercorns. Salt & Twine is committed to clean, responsible food sourcing. Our salami is made exclusively from 100% antibiotic-free pork raised on a vegetarian diet without growth hormones. We keep our ingredients simple and natural: free from synthetic nitrates, nitrites, gluten, soy, and artificial preservatives. Whether sliced thin for a weekend wine and cheese night, paired with crostini and fruit, or added to a gourmet charcuterie board, Salt & Twine Cacio e Pepe brings a sophisticated taste of Italy directly to your table. Storage & Prep: Remove outer casing before slicing. Serve at room temperature for maximum aroma and flavor development. Refrigerate after opening.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The story behind PHNB begins in the mid-90s. Several ranchers got together to discuss the current trends in the beef industry and how to add value to beef products. They discovered that they were all experiencing the same confusion. Why is it that I am producing top quality cattle and yet all I hear at grocery stores and restaurants is that beef isn't as good as it used to be? As it turned out, the cattle that came from the ranches of Wheeler County were being lost in the mix of cattle from all over North America. Their cattle were being blended into pens that held cattle of lower quality. This beef, in turn, was being sent to the market and restaurants, resulting in unhappy consumers. Those ranchers decided to do something. They formed a corporation called Painted Hills Premium Beef, Inc. the groundwork for Painted Hills Natural Beef. The Natural Beef name was born out of a desire to better reflect the focus of the organization.  Painted Hills Natural beef is raised with No Added Hormones, No Antibiotics, Pasture Raised and fed a 100% Vegetarian Diet. Our cattle are never fed animal by-products of any kind. This is beef you can trust.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: In our family, a dinner party is not complete without tortilla chips, salsa, and guacamole. Our grain free chips are dairy-free, powered by avocado oil, and made with natural ingredients (and lots of love!). With a selection of flavors like Sea Salt, Lime, Nacho, Fuego, Ranch, Sal y Limón, and No Salt, we hope there’s a flavor that speaks to everyone. Delicious as a solo act or in queso, bean dip, or hot sauce—but the real magic is when our tortilla chips are enjoyed with family and friends around the table. Our Grain Free Tortilla Chips come in all different flavors, shapes and sizes! Our five-ounce tortilla chips are large format, light and crispy cantina-style tortilla chips, while our four-ounce tortilla chips are smaller, thicker triangles full of seasoning: • Sea Salt (5oz) • Lime (5oz) • No Salt (5oz) • Nacho (5oz) • Fuego (4oz) • Ranch (4oz) • Sal y Limón (4oz) • Nacho (4oz)

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: The Solely Difference - A new way to think about the food we eat. Snacks made from one whole fruit, chocolate made without sugar, and new ways to bring vegetables to the dinner table. Reimagining the possibilities of simple, healthy, and flavorful. Nothing but the fruit. No sugars, preservatives, or concentrates. Just 1, 2, or 3 wholefood organic ingredients, listed on the front of the package and nothing else. Fresh fruit on the go. Introducing the fun way for kids to eat whole, organic fruit with none of the mess and all of the flavor! Simply delicious, organic ingredients. Our organic dried fruit is perfect when plain, decadent when drizzled, and spectacular when spicy. Ultra clean and convenient. Leveraging technology instead of trickery to create the first organic fruit snacks that use whole, fresh fruit that you can take on the go! Irresistibly flavorful. Perfectly sun-ripened and hand-picked at peak freshness, our whole, organic fruit is used to deliver the most delicious fruit snacks. Sustainably sourced and zero waste. Through our Solely Family Farms Initiative, we use full harvest, even ugly fruit, and all parts of the fruit. We use nearly 100% of a farm's yield and have converted thousands of acres of family-owned farmland to organic! Fruit Jerky. The adventure companion, for when you are out and about, on the go, or need a mess-free, nutritious snack in between meals! Gummies. The quick, fun, kid-friendly option, is perfect for packing in your lunch box, sharing, or when you just need a clean pick-me-up. Dried Fruit - The pantry staple, quick and easy, on the go travel snack that is gently dried to perfection. Are Solely products gluten free? Solely spaghetti squash and green banana fusilli pasta are certified gluten free snacks or meals. For non-certified food, Solely avoids cross-contamination using strict allergen control and cleaning protocols between production runs. However, our food is made with the same equipment as tree nuts, soy, and peanuts.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Chicken and Wild Rice Soup. This organic soup has tender organic chicken, wild and brown rice and a variety of organically grown vegetables. Parsley and other seasonings round out the flavor of this gluten free soup, bringing a classic recipe to a whole new level of goodness. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings or pair soups with a salad, sandwich or wrap. USDA Certified Organic and made with non-GMO ingredients, this organic chicken soup contains 11 grams of protein per can and is made with no MSG, high fructose corn syrup, artificial colors or artificial flavors. To prepare, simply pour it into a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, heat until hot, stir and enjoy. Every spoonful of our microwave soup is satisfying to the last drop. The soup can is recyclable for easy disposal. In addition to our Chicken and Wild Rice, we offer Chicken Noodle, Vegetable Lentil and more. At Pacific Foods, we're dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Spicy Chicken Noodle Soup. This USDA Certified Organic soup is consciously crafted with non-GMO ingredients, including chicken meat with no antibiotics, egg noodles, carrots, and celery. Red jalapeno peppers and other spices add a fiery kick to every spoonful, creating an organic chicken noodle soup with a Medium heat level. With 13g of protein per container, this convenient canned soup makes it easy to be intentional about the way you stock your pantry. Enjoy the organic chicken soup on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings, or pair it with a salad, sandwich, or wrap. To prepare, simply microwave on high for 2.5 to 3 minutes, or heat in a saucepan on the stove, stirring occasionally. Each 16.1 oz recyclable can contains two cups of microwave soup. In addition to Spicy Chicken Noodle, Pacific Foods offers Chicken and Wild Rice, Greek-Style Chicken Orzo Soup With Lemon and Herb, and more. At Pacific Foods, we’re dedicated to making the most nourishing foods possible from simple, carefully sourced ingredients.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Immerse your taste buds into something truly unique with Pacific Foods Organic Vegetable Lentil Soup. This organic soup has the rich flavor of lentils and black beans. Fire-roasted red peppers and vine-ripened tomatoes round out the flavor of this plant based soup. Enjoy it on its own as a quick and easy snack, customize it with your favorite toppings or pair soups with a salad, sandwich or wrap. USDA Certified Organic and made with non-GMO ingredients, this vegetable soup contains 14 grams of protein per can, is a good source of fiber* and is made with no MSG, high fructose corn syrup, artificial colors or artificial flavors added. Each 16.3-ounce recyclable can contains one serving. To prepare, pour into a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl, heat until hot, stir and enjoy. Microwave on high for 3 minutes and let stand for 1 minute. Every spoonful of our vegan soup is satisfying to the last drop. In addition to our Vegetable Lentil soup, we offer Chicken Noodle, Chicken and Wild Rice and more. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Suja Organic Turmeric Love Cold Pressed Juice Drink is a spicy twist on lemonade, balancing the power of fresh-pressed turmeric with a zesty combo of tart and spice that fills your heart and taste buds with happiness. This probiotic juice blends a tangy lemonade flavor with delicious notes of pineapple and passion fruit, along with turmeric and black pepper for optimal absorption. Featuring functional ingredients, this Suja juice blend is an excellent source of vitamin C, contains ginger plus probiotics. Suja Organic Turmeric Love is lightly sweetened with stevia, contains no added sugar and has only 2 grams of naturally occurring sugar in each serving. The combination of purified water plus organic lemon juice, organic turmeric, organic ginger, organic pineapple juice and organic passion fruit juice creates a sweet turmeric lemonade topped off with tropical notes. This Suja Organic juice drink pairs great with a meal and a sunny day. Suja Organic Turmeric Love is Non-GMO Project Verified, vegan and gluten free. We make next-level nutrition because if you are going to sip something, you ought to make it count.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Say hello to pasta again with Three Farm Daughters. If you're seeking a pasta that's high in fiber, low in net carbs and has a low glycemic index with fewer calories, we invite you to try our pasta. Our high fiber noodles are crafted from just two ingredients: wheat flour & Durum semolina flour—crops grown on our family farm in North Dakota and sourced from other Midwestern farms. These bulk cavatappi pasta noodles are described as nothing short of sturdy and delicious, holding their ground with the heaviest of sauces and toppings. Plus, they are free from enrichments, fillers, dyes, preservatives & additives. The nutritional benefits come from the non-GMO specialty wheat we cultivate. This resistant starch wheat resists digestion until it reaches your large intestine, where it slowly breaks down and nourishes your microbiome. By resisting rapid digestion, this high-fiber resistant starch wheat helps lower your body’s glycemic index response, increases GLP-1, keeps you feeling full longer, promotes good gut health & aids regularity. With 4.5 times the fiber content of traditional pasta and 10% fewer calories, our dried pasta noodles are designed to please your palate while supporting GI health. Prepare the best pasta dishes knowing you're using ingredients that are gentle on your body and satisfying to your taste buds. Three Farm Daughters Pasta is real pasta, not made from alternative ingredients. It offers the familiar taste of traditional high fiber gourmet pasta without the less preferred flavors of whole wheat, vegetable-based, or low-carb alternatives. Conveniently store our 12 oz pasta in your pantry. This bronze-cut pasta includes (1) Long Cavatappi Pasta Box. To cook our boxed pasta, bring 4-6 qt. of water to a boil. Add a generous pinch of sea salt. Now, it's time for the pasta. Boil for 11-13 minutes or until al dente, stirring occasionally. Make sure to prepare extra—lots extra—because it tastes great as leftovers. Drain, serve & enjoy!

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony’s Chocolonely is more than just chocolate; it’s a mission driven brand that seeks to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. With Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa, each bite you take can help combat the widespread issues of child labor, forced labor, and unsustainable farming practices. By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a sustainable, ethical, and transparent supply chain that prioritizes farmers and the environment. Our chocolate bars and chocolate chunks come in a wide range of irresistible flavors, perfect for snacks or desserts. From Milk Chocolate to Dark Chocolate Almond Sea Salt, each variety is crafted with care to provide a truly indulgent experience. For those who crave a mix of everything, our Tiny Tony Variety Pack offers 14 individually wrapped chunks in 6 delicious flavors, including Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt, Honey Almond Nougat, Almond Sea Salt, and Dark Milk Chocolate Pretzel Toffee—a delight for every taste. These chocolate bars make the perfect gift, whether for a birthday, holiday, or special occasion. And with chocolate this good, there’s no reason to wait! At Tony’s, we also focus on the long term—we work directly with cocoa cooperatives for at least five years to build lasting relationships and create sustainable change. This stability allows farmers to invest in improved farming practices, increase their yields, and reduce deforestation. Tony’s even implements a Child Labor Monitoring and Remediation System to encourage that all workers are regarded with fairness and respect. By purchasing Tony’s Chocolonely, you’re choosing chocolate made with clean ingredients and supporting a movement that demands transparency in the cocoa industry. So whether you’re grabbing a quick snack, enjoying a cozy evening with chocolate desserts, or looking for a sweet gift, know that Tony’s is the chocolate you can feel good about. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Tony's Chocolonely Milk Chocolate Bar is a silky-smooth and downright delicious 32% milk chocolate bar that's changing the chocolate industry. These vibrant red-wrapped wonders are made with traceable cocoa and exist to support the wellbeing of cocoa farmers and their families. Our all-natural bars were Fairtrade Certified from the start and made with outstanding non-GMO ingredients. You’ll notice that each bar has a dynamic, uneven pattern that makes it a bit difficult to share equally. With these unequal divisions, we present an important story about the inequality along the chocolate supply chain. Share a bar of our outstanding milk chocolate and in doing so, help us share our recipe for slave-free chocolate. Includes one 1.8 oz. Milk Chocolate Bar. Right now, slaves are working on cocoa farms in West Africa. Many of them are children. Tony's Chocolonely exists to change that. Our vision is 100% slave-free chocolate. Not just our chocolate, but all chocolate worldwide. With incredibly tasty chocolate, we lead by example to show the world chocolate can be made differently. The more people choose slave-free and share our story, the sooner 100% slave-free becomes the norm in chocolate. The choice is yours. Are you in?

Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—indulge with a bar that’s as flavorful as it is meaningful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s changing the cocoa industry for the better.

When you choose Tony’s, you’re helping support farmers to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. We’re committed to creating a sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry, and every purchase you make helps us continue that mission. The Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt & Cookie Mix Snackable Bits are perfect for when you need a quick snack, a little dessert to share, or a sweet indulgence during a break. These convenient, individually wrapped bites make it easy to enjoy a delicious chocolate experience wherever you are. Packed with flavor and texture, they offer the perfect mix of creamy milk chocolate, rich caramel, the savory touch of sea salt, and the delightful crunch of cookie bits. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Introducing Tony’s Milk Hazelnut Bar—the chocolate bar that delivers the perfect combination of creamy and nutty indulgence! Packed with 32% milk chocolate and at least 10% hazelnuts, each bite offers a delightful balance of rich, milky chocolate and crunchy hazelnuts. It’s the ultimate chocolate experience for anyone who loves the bold flavors of Belgian chocolate and the perfect crunch of hazelnuts! At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should be more than just a tasty delight—it should make a difference. That’s why we’re on a mission to end exploitation in the cocoa industry. Every bar of Milk Hazelnut Bar is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. By choosing Tony’s, you’re not just enjoying a delicious chocolate bar, you’re supporting a movement that prioritizes transparency, sustainability, and fair wages for farmers. We work directly with cocoa cooperatives to support the farmers we partner with to earn a living income and work in safe, fair conditions. The Milk Hazelnut Bar is a perfect example of how Tony’s combines exceptional flavor with a meaningful mission. From the first bite, you’ll experience the richness of the milk chocolate, followed by the satisfying crunch of the hazelnuts. Together, they create a harmonious balance of textures and flavors that is simply unforgettable. Whether you’re indulging yourself, sharing with friends, or looking for the perfect gift, The Milk Hazelnut Bar is sure to satisfy every craving. It’s the ultimate combination of creamy chocolate and crunchy nuts, all in one delicious, satisfying bar. Plus, with every purchase, you’re helping create a more sustainable, ethical, and fair chocolate industry. So go ahead—enjoy a bar that’s as satisfying as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Get ready for a campfire classic, now in snackable form! Tony’s S’mores Mix Lil' Bits are the perfect snack for anyone craving that nostalgic s’mores flavor. Packed with fluffy, melt-in-your-mouth marshmallows, crispy graham cracker pieces, coated in rich milk chocolate, every bite delivers the ultimate balance of sweet, crunchy, and chocolatey goodness. Whether you’re at home, work, or on the go, these convenient, bite-sized nibbles make it easy to enjoy the taste of s’mores anytime, anywhere. Perfect for satisfying your sweet tooth, sharing with friends, or packing for an outdoor adventure, these S’mores Snackable Bits are the ideal snack for every occasion. At Tony’s, we believe that chocolate should do more than just taste amazing—it should make a positive impact. That’s why every bite of our S’mores Snackable Bits is made with Fairtrade traceable cocoa sourced from farms in West Africa. When you choose Tony’s, you’re not just indulging in a delicious candy; you’re supporting a movement that supports cocoa farmers to get paid a living income and work in fair, safe conditions. We are committed to creating a more sustainable, ethical, and transparent chocolate industry, and every purchase helps drive this mission forward. Tony’s S’mores Snackable Bits are perfect for everyone who loves the classic campfire tradition, but without the need for a fire. Whether you’re taking a break during work, hanging out at home, or looking for a sweet snack on the go, these delicious bites are easy to grab and indulge in. They offer a delightful texture with the chewiness of the marshmallow, the crunch of the graham crackers, and the creamy, smooth richness of Tony’s signature milk chocolate. And be warned—these irresistible snackable bits tend to run out quickly, so grab a bag (or two). Introduce yourself to a snack that’s as fun as it is flavorful, and feel good knowing you’re supporting a brand that’s working to change the cocoa industry for the better.

With low sugar (just 4–5 g per bar) and only 140 calories, these individually wrapped protein bars make it easy to snack smart anytime, anywhere. whole_foods_store_specific_products.retailer_description: Named for a long-shuttered beauty parlor that housed the first Stumptown location, Stumptown Hair Bender was the very first blend that Stumptown founder Duane Sorenson introduced to the world. In fact, we still have the Hair Bender sign in our headquarters, watching over us as we roast each batch. Hair Bender is a complex blend featuring coffee from three major growing regions; Central and South America, East Africa, and Indonesia. Its complexity is what allows for a harmonious flavor profile of sweet citrus, milk chocolate, and caramel. We continually taste this blend and each of its components, both on the cupping table as well as espresso, to best maintain the balance of flavors. Nearly 20 years ago, Stumptown Coffee Roasters began roasting exemplary coffee. Headquartered in Portland, Oregon, Stumptown is committed to sourcing, roasting and serving some of the best coffee in the world. Achieving B Corp status in 2018, Stumptown strives to be a leader in sustainability and is focused on making sincere and lasting contributions to the environment as well as to their employees and community.

whole_foods_store_price_differences.retailer_description: At ALOHA, we believe that plants are the ultimate source of nourishment, and that real foods should be really convenient. So when you’re looking for a great tasting, organic, plant-based protein boost, we’ve got you covered. With 14g clean protein and only 5g of natural sugar, ALOHA’s protein bars are the perfect, healthy snack to tide you over. Our thoughtfully selected, plant-based protein is sourced from a balanced mix of organic pumpkin seed and organic brown rice, to deliver steady energy that will carry you through the day without the dreaded sugar crash.
