ALOHA checks the all the boxes, so you can enjoy a tasty, nutritious snack without hesitation. All of our protein bars and protein products are made free of artificial ingredients and free of sugar alcohols, because we know that what you eat and how you feel are intimately connected. ALOHA’s organic, plant-based Chocolate Mint protein bars use a short line of organic, whole-food ingredients that are delicious and self-explanatory: like real, organic dark chocolate, organic cashew butter, and organic peppermint oil. The perfect protein bar for when you’re between meetings, warming up for the gym or cooling down, on the road, taking a pit-stop on your weekend cycle, or looking for an easy, nutritious option at home. The search for a healthy, satisfying, go-to snack is over: sit back and enjoy a great tasting, rejuvenating ALOHA protein bar.

whole_foods_store_price_differences.retailer_description: Raeburn is an Olde English term which means "the river where one goes to drink." So, it's fitting that Raeburn's expressive, beautifully balanced wines begin in the heart of the Russian River Valley where some of the world's finest Burgundy grapes are grown. The Russian River Valley opens to the Pacific Ocean allowing cool fog and breezes to flow directly into the vineyards. Chardonnay and Pinot Noir grapes benefit greatly from this maritime influence which fosters a longer more temperate growing season and yields fill flavored, complex wines with well-balanced acidity. The Russian River Valley appellation lies at the geographical heart of Sonoma County; this is where some of wine country's best known and most beloved varietals really earned their reputation, setting the standard for California Pinot Noir and Chardonnay, while remaining home to sought-after old vine Zinfandel.

By choosing Tony’s, you’re supporting a sustainable, ethical, and transparent supply chain that prioritizes farmers and the environment. Our chocolate bars and chocolate chunks come in a wide range of irresistible flavors, perfect for snacks or desserts. From Milk Chocolate to Dark Chocolate Almond Sea Salt, each variety is crafted with care to provide a truly indulgent experience. For those who crave a mix of everything, our Tiny Tony Variety Pack offers 36 individually wrapped coins in 6 delicious flavors, including Milk Chocolate Caramel Sea Salt, Honey Almond Nougat, Almond Sea Salt, and Dark Milk Chocolate Pretzel Toffee—a delight for every taste. These chocolate bars make the perfect gift, whether for a birthday, holiday, or special occasion. And with chocolate this good, there’s no reason to wait! At Tony’s, we also focus on the long term—we work directly with cocoa cooperatives for at least five years to build lasting relationships and create sustainable change. This stability allows farmers to invest in improved farming practices, increase their yields, and reduce deforestation. Tony’s even implements a Child Labor Monitoring and Remediation System to encourage that all workers are regarded with fairness and respect. By purchasing Tony’s Chocolonely, you’re choosing chocolate made with clean ingredients and supporting a movement that demands transparency in the cocoa industry. So whether you’re grabbing a quick snack, enjoying a cozy evening with chocolate desserts, or looking for a sweet gift, know that Tony’s is the chocolate you can feel good about. Join us in the fight for a fairer, more sustainable world.

Due to its long shelf life, it was common among shepherds who traversed the island with their flocks for seasons at a time. recommendations.title: Recover source data before guessing from images
recommendations.detail: 2 products have no image-classifier row. Retailer product types, descriptions and explicit product forms take precedence over image guesses.

recommendations.title: Prefer source-backed rules over broad keyword guessing
recommendations.detail: Use reliable source fields like Fresh Produce, retailer breadcrumbs, and product-detail metadata before adding keyword rules that can move drinks, supplements, or personal care into the wrong shelf.

recommendations.title: Use gold labels as training data
recommendations.detail: Pick representative products from repeated failed brands and product families. One good label can help a whole cluster through the local text model.
